rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Credit Amount - Mandatory Field Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Current Cycle Credit amount has been provided by the user before any format checks are performed. This is a mandatory field on the account update screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Current Cycle Credit Amount blank or missing?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and the Current Cycle Credit amount field is part of the editable fields being validated
acceptance_criteria.When: The Current Cycle Credit amount field is left blank, contains only spaces, or contains no value (low-values)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Credit amount is marked as invalid with a blank indicator, the overall input is flagged as containing an error, and the error message 'Current Cycle Credit Limit must be supplied.' is recorded as the active error message (only if no prior error message has already been set), and validation ends for this field

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Credit Amount - Valid Signed Numeric Format Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Current Cycle Credit amount, when provided, is a properly formatted signed numeric value (allowing currency signs and decimal notation). This ensures the value can be correctly stored as a financial amount.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is the value a valid signed numeric amount?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and the Current Cycle Credit amount field has been provided with a non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The provided Current Cycle Credit amount value fails the signed numeric currency validation check (i.e., it is not a valid signed numeric value such as containing invalid characters or improper formatting)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Credit amount is marked as invalid with a not-valid indicator, the overall input is flagged as containing an error, and the error message 'Current Cycle Credit Limit is not valid' is recorded as the active error message (only if no prior error message has already been set), and validation ends for this field

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Credit Amount - Mark as Valid
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the Current Cycle Credit amount has passed all validation checks — it is present and is a properly formatted signed numeric value — and marks it as valid for further processing and update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Current Cycle Credit Amount as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and the Current Cycle Credit amount field has been provided with a non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Current Cycle Credit amount passes both the mandatory presence check and the signed numeric format validation check
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Credit amount is marked as valid, indicating it is acceptable for use in the account update, and no error is raised for this field

key_functionalities.title: Current Cycle Debit Validation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:

    START([Start: Current Cycle Debit Validation])

    CHECKNUMERIC{Is the value a\nvalid signed\nnumeric amount?\neg. 1234.56 or -1234.56}
    NUMERROR[Mark as Invalid\nError: 'Current Cycle Debit Limit\nis not valid']
    VALID[Mark Current Cycle\nDebit Amount as Valid]
    END([End: Current Cycle\nDebit Validation Complete])

    START --> CHECKBLANK
    CHECKBLANK -->|Yes - Not Supplied| BLANKERROR

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Debit Amount - Mandatory Field Presence Check
rules.rule_description: Ensures that the Current Cycle Debit amount field is not left empty when a user submits account update details. The field is mandatory and must contain a value before any further validation is performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Current Cycle Debit Amount blank or missing?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details, and changes have been detected between the original and newly entered values
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen and the Current Cycle Debit amount field is blank or contains no value
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Debit amount is marked as invalid, the overall input is flagged as containing an error, and the error message 'Current Cycle Debit Limit must be supplied.' is recorded as the first error message (only if no prior error message has already been set)

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Debit Amount - Signed Numeric Format Validation
rules.rule_description: Ensures that the Current Cycle Debit amount, when supplied, is a properly formatted signed numeric value that can represent a monetary amount, including support for positive and negative values with up to two decimal places.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is the value a valid signed numeric amount? eg. 1234.56 or -1234.56

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the Current Cycle Debit amount field has been supplied with a non-blank value, and changes have been detected between the original and newly entered values
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen and the value entered in the Current Cycle Debit amount field is not a valid signed numeric currency value (e.g., contains letters, special characters, or is otherwise not parseable as a signed number)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Debit amount is marked as invalid, the overall input is flagged as containing an error, and the error message 'Current Cycle Debit Limit is not valid' is recorded as the first error message (only if no prior error message has already been set)

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Debit Amount - Successful Validation
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the Current Cycle Debit amount has passed all validation checks — it is present and is a valid signed numeric currency value — and marks it as valid so that the update process may proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Current Cycle Debit Amount as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the Current Cycle Debit amount field has been supplied with a non-blank value, and changes have been detected between the original and newly entered values
acceptance_criteria.When: The Current Cycle Debit amount passes both the mandatory presence check and the signed numeric format check
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Debit amount is marked as valid, and the validated numeric value is stored internally for use in the account update record

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Debit Amount - Input Capture and Numeric Conversion
rules.rule_description: Defines how the Current Cycle Debit amount is captured from the user's screen input before validation begins. An asterisk '*' or blank entry is treated as a cleared/empty field. If a value is present and is a valid signed numeric, it is also converted to its internal numeric representation for downstream processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Start: Current Cycle Debit Validation

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered a value (or left blank) in the Current Cycle Debit amount field on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen input is received by the system
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the entered value is an asterisk '*' or spaces, the Current Cycle Debit amount is treated as blank and cleared internally; if a non-blank value is entered and it is a valid signed numeric currency value, it is stored both as a text value and converted to its numeric equivalent for processing; if the value is non-blank but not a valid signed numeric, only the text value is stored and the numeric conversion is skipped

rules.rule_name: Current Cycle Debit Amount - Error Field Highlighting on Screen
rules.rule_description: Defines how the screen visually communicates a Current Cycle Debit validation error to the user by highlighting the field in red and placing the cursor on it. If the field was blank, an asterisk placeholder is also shown to indicate the field requires input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Mark as Invalid
Error: 'Current Cycle Debit Limit must be supplied' / 'Current Cycle Debit Limit is not valid'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Current Cycle Debit amount field has failed validation (either blank or invalid format) and the screen is being re-displayed to the user after a submission attempt

rules.rule_name: SSN First 3 Digits - Presence Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the first 3 digits of the Social Security Number have been entered by the user and are not blank or missing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First 3 Digits Supplied?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN first 3 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-1) is being validated
acceptance_criteria.When: The first 3 digits of the SSN are blank, contain only spaces, or have zero trimmed length (i.e., nothing was entered)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid by setting INPUT-ERROR to TRUE and FLG-ALPHNANUM-BLANK to TRUE for SSN Part 1; the validation flags are stored in WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-FLGS; if no prior error message has been set, the error message 'SSN: First 3 chars must be supplied.' is recorded; validation of the first 3 digits stops immediately and processing continues with the middle 2 digits validation

rules.rule_name: SSN First 3 Digits - Numeric Format Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the first 3 digits of the Social Security Number contain only numeric characters.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First 3 Digits All Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN first 3 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-1) has been supplied (is not blank)
acceptance_criteria.When: The first 3 digits of the SSN contain any non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid by setting INPUT-ERROR to TRUE and FLG-ALPHNANUM-NOT-OK to TRUE for SSN Part 1; the validation flags are stored in WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-FLGS; if no prior error message has been set, the error message 'SSN: First 3 chars must be all numeric.' is recorded; validation of the first 3 digits stops immediately and processing continues with the middle 2 digits validation

rules.rule_name: SSN First 3 Digits - Non-Zero Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the first 3 digits of the Social Security Number are not all zeros.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First 3 Digits Non-Zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN first 3 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-1) has been supplied and confirmed as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric value of the first 3 digits of the SSN equals zero (i.e., '000')
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid by setting INPUT-ERROR to TRUE and FLG-ALPHNANUM-NOT-OK to TRUE for SSN Part 1; the validation flags are stored in WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-FLGS; if no prior error message has been set, the error message 'SSN: First 3 chars must not be zero.' is recorded; validation of the first 3 digits stops immediately and processing continues with the middle 2 digits validation

rules.rule_name: SSN First 3 Digits - Restricted Range Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the first 3 digits of the Social Security Number do not fall within federally restricted SSN prefix ranges. The values 000, 666, and the range 900-999 are not valid SSN prefixes per US Social Security Administration rules.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First 3 Digits Not 000, 666, or 900-999?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN first 3 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-1) has passed the presence, numeric, and non-zero checks (FLG-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-ISVALID is TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.When: The first 3 digits of the SSN match any of the restricted values: 000, 666, or any value between 900 and 999 inclusive (as determined by the INVALID-SSN-PART1 condition evaluated against WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid by setting INPUT-ERROR to TRUE and FLG-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-NOT-OK to TRUE; if no prior error message has been set, the error message 'SSN: First 3 chars: should not be 000, 666, or between 900 and 999' is recorded; processing continues with the middle 2 digits validation

rules.rule_name: SSN First 3 Digits - Valid
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the first 3 digits of the SSN have passed all validation checks and are marked as valid.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First 3 Digits Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN first 3 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-1) is being validated
acceptance_criteria.When: The first 3 digits are supplied, all numeric, non-zero, and do not fall within the restricted ranges (000, 666, 900-999)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID to TRUE for SSN Part 1, and the validation flags are stored in WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-FLGS; processing continues to validate the middle 2 digits of the SSN

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN middle 2 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-2) is being validated
acceptance_criteria.When: The middle 2 digits are supplied, all numeric, and non-zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID to TRUE for SSN Part 2, and the validation flags are stored in WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART2-FLGS; processing continues to validate the last 4 digits of the SSN

rules.rule_name: SSN Last 4 Digits - Presence Check

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN last 4 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-3) is being validated after completion of Part 1 and Part 2 validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The last 4 digits of the SSN are blank, contain only spaces, or have zero trimmed length (i.e., nothing was entered)

rules.rule_name: SSN Last 4 Digits - Numeric Format Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the last 4 digits of the Social Security Number contain only numeric characters.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN last 4 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-3) has been supplied (is not blank)

rules.rule_name: SSN Last 4 Digits - Non-Zero Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the last 4 digits of the Social Security Number are not all zeros.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and the SSN last 4 digits field (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-3) is being validated
acceptance_criteria.When: The last 4 digits are supplied, all numeric, and non-zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets FLG-ALPHNANUM-ISVALID to TRUE for SSN Part 3, and the validation flags are stored in WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART3-FLGS; SSN validation ends and validation flags for all three parts are returned to the calling validation process

rules.rule_name: SSN Validation - Sequential Three-Part Processing
rules.rule_description: Defines the overall SSN validation process as a sequential three-part validation where all three parts are always evaluated independently, regardless of errors found in earlier parts, and all validation flags are returned to the caller.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End SSN Validation Return Validation Flags for All Three Parts

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen and has entered values in the SSN fields (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-1, ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-2, ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN-3)
acceptance_criteria.When: The SSN validation routine (1265-EDIT-US-SSN) is invoked from the field-level edit process (1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS) with the field label set to 'SSN'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system validates all three SSN parts sequentially and independently — Part 1 (first 3 digits, field label 'SSN: First 3 chars'), Part 2 (middle 2 digits, field label 'SSN 4th & 5th chars'), and Part 3 (last 4 digits, field label 'SSN Last 4 chars') — even if earlier parts have errors; upon completion, the individual validation flags (WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-FLGS, WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART2-FLGS, WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART3-FLGS) are all set and returned to the calling process for use in screen error highlighting and update eligibility determination

rules.rule_name: FICO Score Must Be Supplied
rules.rule_description: Validates that the FICO credit score field is not left blank or empty when a user submits account update details. The FICO Score is a mandatory field and must contain a value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is FICO Score Supplied?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and the FICO Score field is part of the editable customer information
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form with the FICO Score field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the FICO Score field as invalid, sets an input error condition, records the error message 'FICO Score must be supplied.' (only if no prior error message has been recorded in the session), and flags the FICO Score field to be highlighted in red on the screen; processing of the FICO Score validation stops immediately

rules.rule_name: FICO Score Must Be All Numeric
rules.rule_description: Validates that the FICO credit score contains only numeric digits. Non-numeric characters such as letters or special symbols are not permitted in the FICO Score field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is FICO Score All Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and has supplied a non-blank value in the FICO Score field
acceptance_criteria.When: The supplied FICO Score value contains any non-numeric characters (letters, symbols, or mixed content) within its 3-character length
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the FICO Score field as invalid, sets an input error condition, records the error message 'FICO Score must be all numeric.' (only if no prior error message has been recorded in the session), and flags the FICO Score field to be highlighted in red on the screen; processing of the FICO Score validation stops immediately

rules.rule_name: FICO Score Must Be Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: Validates that the FICO credit score is not zero. A FICO Score of zero is not a valid credit score and must be rejected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is FICO Score Non-Zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and has supplied a numeric value in the FICO Score field
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric value of the FICO Score evaluates to zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the FICO Score field as invalid, sets an input error condition, records the error message 'FICO Score must not be zero.' (only if no prior error message has been recorded in the session), and flags the FICO Score field to be highlighted in red on the screen; processing of the FICO Score validation stops immediately

rules.rule_name: FICO Score Must Fall Within Valid Range of 300 to 850
rules.rule_description: Validates that the FICO credit score falls within the industry-standard valid range of 300 to 850 inclusive. This range check is only performed after the score has passed the numeric and non-zero checks.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is FICO Score Between 300 and 850?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and has supplied a FICO Score value that has already passed the mandatory, numeric, and non-zero checks
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric FICO Score value is outside the valid range — that is, it is less than 300 or greater than 850
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the FICO Score field as invalid, sets an input error condition, records the error message 'FICO Score: should be between 300 and 850' (only if no prior error message has been recorded in the session), and flags the FICO Score field to be highlighted in red on the screen

rules.rule_name: FICO Score Is Valid — Proceed to Next Validation
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the FICO credit score has passed all validation checks — it is supplied, numeric, non-zero, and within the range of 300 to 850 — and the validation process proceeds to the next field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
FICO Score is Valid
Proceed to Next Validation

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and has supplied a value in the FICO Score field
acceptance_criteria.When: The FICO Score value is non-blank, is entirely numeric, is non-zero, and falls within the range of 300 to 850 inclusive
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the FICO Score field as valid (FLG-FICO-SCORE-ISVALID), no error condition is set for this field, no error message is generated for this field, and the validation process continues to the next field on the screen

rules.rule_name: FICO Score Range Validation Is Conditionally Invoked
rules.rule_description: Defines the conditional action rule that the FICO Score range check (300–850) is only invoked when the FICO Score has already been confirmed as valid through the prior numeric and non-zero checks. The range validation is skipped entirely if earlier checks have already failed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is FICO Score Between 300 and 850?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account details on the Account Update screen and the FICO Score field has been submitted for validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The FICO Score has passed the mandatory, numeric, and non-zero checks and is flagged as valid (FLG-FICO-SCORE-ISVALID is set to TRUE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the FICO Score range validation routine to check whether the score falls between 300 and 850; if the FICO Score did not pass the prior checks, the range validation routine is not invoked and the field remains flagged as invalid

rules.rule_name: First Name Mandatory Presence Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the customer First Name field is not left blank or empty when submitting account update details. First Name is a required field and must be supplied by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is First Name blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details, and changes have been detected requiring validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form with the First Name field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful characters (empty after trimming)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The First Name field is marked as invalid, an input error state is set, and the error message 'First Name must be supplied.' is displayed to the user (only if no prior error message has already been set)

rules.rule_name: First Name Alphabetic Character Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the customer First Name field contains only alphabetic characters (A-Z, a-z) and spaces. No numeric digits or special characters are permitted in the First Name field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does First Name contain only alphabetic characters and spaces?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, has fetched account details, changes have been detected, and the First Name field has been supplied with a non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form and the First Name value (up to 25 characters) contains any characters that are not alphabetic letters or spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The First Name field is marked as invalid, an input error state is set, and the error message 'First Name can have alphabets only.' is displayed to the user (only if no prior error message has already been set)

rules.rule_name: First Name Valid Acceptance
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the customer First Name field passes all validation checks — it is non-blank and contains only alphabetic characters and spaces — and is accepted as a valid input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: First Name is Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details with changes detected requiring validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The First Name field is supplied with a non-blank value of up to 25 characters that contains only alphabetic letters and spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The First Name field is marked as valid and no error is raised for this field; processing continues to the Middle Name validation

rules.rule_name: Middle Name Optional Field Check
rules.rule_description: Determines whether the Middle Name field has been provided. Middle Name is an optional field; if it is left blank or empty, it is automatically accepted as valid and no further validation is performed on it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Middle Name blank or empty? / Middle Name is Valid - Field is Optional - Skip Further Checks

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details with changes detected requiring validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form with the Middle Name field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful characters (empty after trimming)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Middle Name field is marked as valid without any error, and processing continues directly to Last Name validation without checking the content of the Middle Name field

rules.rule_name: Middle Name Alphabetic Character Check

rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does Middle Name contain only alphabetic characters and spaces?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, has fetched account details, changes have been detected, and the Middle Name field has been supplied with a non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form and the Middle Name value (up to 25 characters) contains any characters that are not alphabetic letters or spaces

rules.rule_name: Middle Name Valid Acceptance
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the customer Middle Name field, when provided, passes the alphabetic character validation and is accepted as a valid input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Middle Name is Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, has fetched account details, changes have been detected, and the Middle Name field has been supplied with a non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The Middle Name value (up to 25 characters) contains only alphabetic letters and spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Middle Name field is marked as valid and no error is raised for this field; processing continues to the Last Name validation

rules.rule_name: Last Name Mandatory Presence Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the customer Last Name field is not left blank or empty when submitting account update details. Last Name is a required field and must be supplied by the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Last Name blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details with changes detected requiring validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form with the Last Name field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful characters (empty after trimming)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Last Name field is marked as invalid, an input error state is set, and the error message 'Last Name must be supplied.' is displayed to the user (only if no prior error message has already been set)

rules.rule_name: Last Name Alphabetic Character Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the customer Last Name field contains only alphabetic characters (A-Z, a-z) and spaces. No numeric digits or special characters are permitted in the Last Name field.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, has fetched account details, changes have been detected, and the Last Name field has been supplied with a non-blank value
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form and the Last Name value (up to 25 characters) contains any characters that are not alphabetic letters or spaces
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Last Name field is marked as invalid, an input error state is set, and the error message 'Last Name can have alphabets only.' is displayed to the user (only if no prior error message has already been set)

rules.rule_name: Last Name Valid Acceptance
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the customer Last Name field passes all validation checks — it is non-blank and contains only alphabetic characters and spaces — and is accepted as a valid input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Last Name is Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details with changes detected requiring validation

acceptance_criteria.Then: The Last Name field is marked as valid, no error is raised for this field, and name field validation is complete; processing continues to the next validation group

rules.rule_name: Address Line 1 Mandatory Field Presence Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the customer Address Line 1 field is mandatory and must contain a non-blank, non-empty value before the account update can proceed. This rule is triggered only after account details have been fetched and changes have been detected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Address Line 1 blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has fetched an existing account and customer record, changes have been detected between the original and newly entered values, and the Address Line 1 field (maximum 50 characters) is being validated as part of the full field validation sequence
acceptance_criteria.When: The Address Line 1 field submitted by the user is entirely blank (spaces), contains only low-value characters, or has a trimmed length of zero (i.e., no meaningful content is present)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The overall input is marked as invalid (INPUT-ERROR), the Address Line 1 field is specifically flagged as blank (FLG-ADDRESS-LINE-1-BLANK), and if no prior error message has already been set, the error message 'Address Line 1 must be supplied.' is recorded; validation for this field ends immediately and Address Line 1 is not marked as valid

rules.rule_name: Address Line 1 Successful Validation
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the customer Address Line 1 field passes the mandatory presence check and is marked as valid, allowing the overall account update validation to continue to subsequent fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Address Line 1 as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has fetched an existing account and customer record, changes have been detected between the original and newly entered values, and the Address Line 1 field (maximum 50 characters) is being validated as part of the full field validation sequence
acceptance_criteria.When: The Address Line 1 field submitted by the user contains at least one non-blank, non-low-value character (i.e., the trimmed length is greater than zero)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Address Line 1 field is marked as valid (FLG-ADDRESS-LINE-1-ISVALID / FLG-MANDATORY-ISVALID), no error is raised for this field, and the validation result flag (WS-EDIT-ADDRESS-LINE-1-FLGS) is updated to reflect the valid status so that subsequent processing and screen attribute setup can proceed correctly

rules.rule_name: Address Line 1 Error Message Suppression When Prior Error Exists
rules.rule_description: Enforces the rule that only the first validation error message encountered during the full field validation sequence is displayed to the user. If a prior error message has already been set for another field, the Address Line 1 error message is suppressed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: 'Address Line 1 must be supplied.'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Address Line 1 field has been determined to be blank or empty (validation has failed), and the system is about to set the error message for the user
acceptance_criteria.When: A prior error message has already been set during the current validation pass (i.e., the return message flag is no longer in the 'off' / unset state, meaning WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF is FALSE)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The error message 'Address Line 1 must be supplied.' is NOT written to the return message area, preserving the earlier error message; the field is still flagged as blank and input is still marked as invalid regardless of message suppression

rules.rule_name: Address Line 1 Validation Invocation as Part of Account Update Edit Sequence
rules.rule_description: Defines the process rule that Address Line 1 validation is invoked as a specific step within the full account update field validation sequence, only when account details have already been fetched and user-entered changes have been detected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Validate that address line 1 is mandatory and supplied

acceptance_criteria.Given: An account and its associated customer record have been successfully fetched and displayed on the account update screen, and the user has submitted changes that differ from the originally fetched values
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the full field validation sequence (1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS) and reaches the Address Line 1 validation step, passing the entered Address Line 1 value (up to 50 characters) and the field label 'Address Line 1' to the mandatory field validation routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The mandatory validation routine (1215-EDIT-MANDATORY) is executed for Address Line 1, the resulting validation status flags are stored in WS-EDIT-ADDRESS-LINE-1-FLGS, and the outcome (valid or blank/invalid) is available for subsequent screen attribute setup and error highlighting

key_functionalities.title: State Code Validation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Start: State Code Validation])

    START --> RECEIVE
    RECEIVE --> CHECKBLANK

    CHECKBLANK -->|No - Value Provided| CHECKAPLHA
    CHECKAPLHA -->|No - Non-Alphabetic Characters Found| ALPHAERROR
    CHECKAPLHA -->|Yes - All Alphabetic| CHECKUSSTATE

    BLANKERROR --> END

    STATEERROR --> END

rules.rule_name: State Code Mandatory Supply Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the State Code field is not left blank or empty when the user submits account update details. The State Code is a required field and must be provided.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is State Code Blank or Missing?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has fetched account details and is on the Account Update screen with the State Code field available for editing
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen with the State Code field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful characters (zero-length after trimming)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The State Code field is marked as invalid; an input error is raised; the error message 'State must be supplied.' is set and displayed (only if no prior error message has been set); the State Code field is highlighted in Red on the screen; and if the field was blank, an asterisk '*' is placed in the State Code display field

rules.rule_name: State Code Alphabetic Characters Only Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the State Code field contains only alphabetic characters. No numeric digits or special characters are permitted in a US State Code.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does State Code Contain Only Alphabetic Characters?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has fetched account details and is on the Account Update screen, and the State Code field has been supplied with a non-blank value of up to 2 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen and the State Code value contains one or more non-alphabetic characters (digits, symbols, or special characters)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The State Code field is marked as invalid; an input error is raised; the error message 'State can have alphabets only.' is set and displayed (only if no prior error message has been set); and the State Code field is highlighted in Red on the screen

rules.rule_name: State Code Valid US State Code Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the supplied 2-character alphabetic State Code corresponds to a recognized and valid US State Code from the approved list of US state codes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is State Code a Valid US State Code?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has fetched account details and is on the Account Update screen, and the State Code field has been supplied with a non-blank, 2-character alphabetic value
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen and the State Code value does not match any entry in the valid US State Code reference list
acceptance_criteria.Then: The State Code field is marked as invalid; an input error is raised; the error message 'State: is not a valid state code' is set and displayed (only if no prior error message has been set); and the State Code field is highlighted in Red on the screen

rules.rule_name: State Code Successfully Validated
rules.rule_description: When the State Code passes all individual validations (non-blank, alphabetic only, and valid US state code), it is marked as valid and the process proceeds to the State and Zip Code cross-validation check.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark State Code as Valid - Proceed to State and Zip Code Cross-Validation

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has fetched account details and is on the Account Update screen with a State Code value entered
acceptance_criteria.When: The State Code is non-blank, contains only alphabetic characters, and matches a valid US State Code from the approved reference list
acceptance_criteria.Then: The State Code field is marked as valid; no error is raised for the State Code field; and the validation process proceeds to the State and Zip Code cross-validation (checking that the first 2 digits of the Zip Code are valid for the given State)

rules.rule_name: State Code Field Setup and Length Configuration
rules.rule_description: Before any validation is performed, the State Code value entered by the user is transferred from the screen input area into the validation work area, and the expected field length is set to 2 characters for all subsequent validation checks.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Receive State Code from Screen - Move state code to validation work area - Set field length to 2 characters

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the Account Update screen with a value (or blank) in the State Code field
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins the State Code validation process
acceptance_criteria.Then: The State Code value from the screen input (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD) is moved into the alphanumeric validation work area; the validation field length is set to 2 characters; and the State Code is initially marked as invalid pending successful completion of all validation checks

key_functionalities.title: Zip Code Validation
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start Zip Code Validation]) --> B[Retrieve entered Zip Code value\nfrom screen input\nExpected length: 5 digits]
    B --> C{Is Zip Code\nblank or\nnot supplied?}
    C -->|Yes - Blank| D[/Error: Zip must be supplied/]
    D --> E([End - Validation Failed])
    C -->|No - Value Present| F{Is Zip Code\nall numeric?}
    F -->|No - Contains non-numeric characters| G[/Error: Zip must be all numeric/]
    G --> E
    F -->|Yes - All Numeric| H{Is Zip Code\nvalue zero?}
    H -->|Yes - All Zeros| I[/Error: Zip must not be zero/]
    I --> E
    H -->|No - Non-Zero Value| J[Mark Zip Code as Valid\nFlag set for use in\nState-Zip Cross Validation]
    J --> K([End - Validation Passed])

rules.rule_name: Zip Code Must Be Supplied
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Zip Code field is not left blank or empty when the user submits the account update screen. The Zip Code is a mandatory field and must contain a value before any further validation can proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Zip Code blank or not supplied?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details, and the Zip Code field is left blank, contains only spaces, or contains low values (i.e., no value is entered)
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen for processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid, sets the Zip Code field flag to 'Blank', and displays the error message 'Zip must be supplied.' The Zip Code field is highlighted in red on the screen with an asterisk '*' shown as a placeholder, and no further Zip Code validation is performed

rules.rule_name: Zip Code Must Be All Numeric
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Zip Code field contains only numeric digits. A Zip Code that contains alphabetic or special characters is not acceptable and must be rejected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Zip Code all numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the Zip Code field has been supplied with a value (not blank), and the entered value contains one or more non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen for processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid, sets the Zip Code field flag to 'Not OK', and displays the error message 'Zip must be all numeric.' The Zip Code field is highlighted in red on the screen, and no further Zip Code validation is performed

rules.rule_name: Zip Code Must Not Be Zero
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Zip Code field does not contain an all-zero value. Even if the Zip Code is numeric, a value of zero (e.g., '00000') is not a valid Zip Code and must be rejected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Zip Code value zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the Zip Code field has been supplied with a numeric value, and the numeric value evaluates to zero (e.g., '00000')
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen for processing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the input as invalid, sets the Zip Code field flag to 'Not OK', and displays the error message 'Zip must not be zero.' The Zip Code field is highlighted in red on the screen, and no further Zip Code validation is performed

rules.rule_name: Zip Code Marked Valid for Cross-Validation
rules.rule_description: When the Zip Code passes all individual validations (supplied, all numeric, non-zero), it is marked as valid. This valid flag is then used as a prerequisite condition to trigger the State and Zip Code cross-validation check, which verifies that the first two digits of the Zip Code are consistent with the entered State Code.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Zip Code as Valid - Flag set for use in State-Zip Cross Validation

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the Zip Code field has been supplied with a value that is all numeric and non-zero, and the State Code field has also independently passed its own validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes individual Zip Code validation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the Zip Code validity flag to 'Valid', and subsequently triggers the State-Zip cross-validation check to verify that the combination of the State Code and the first two digits of the Zip Code represents a valid geographic pairing

key_functionalities.title: State and Zip Code Cross
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Start: State & Zip Cross-Validation])
    PREREQ{Are Both State Code\nAND Zip Code\nIndividually Valid?}
    SKIP([Skip Cross-Validation\nPrevious field-level errors\nalready reported])
    COMBINE[Combine State Code with\nFirst 2 Digits of Zip Code\ninto single lookup value]
    CHECKCOMBO{Is the State + Zip Prefix\nCombination Valid per\nUSPS-Based Rules?}
    VALID([Both State and Zip\nAre Consistent\nValidation Passed])
    INVALID[Mark Both State Code\nAND Zip Code Fields\nas Invalid - Highlight in Red]
    ERRMSG[Set Error Message:\n'Invalid zip code for state']
    END([End: Return Validation Result])

    START --> PREREQ
    PREREQ -->|No - One or Both Fields\nAlready Have Errors| SKIP
    PREREQ -->|Yes - Both Fields\nPassed Individual Validation| COMBINE
    COMBINE --> CHECKCOMBO
    CHECKCOMBO -->|Valid Combination| VALID
    CHECKCOMBO -->|Invalid Combination| INVALID
    INVALID --> ERRMSG
    ERRMSG --> END
    VALID --> END
    SKIP --> END

rules.rule_name: Skip State-Zip Cross-Validation When Individual Field Errors Exist
rules.rule_description: Before performing the State and Zip Code cross-validation, the system checks whether both the State Code and Zip Code fields have individually passed their own field-level validations. If either field already has an error, the cross-validation is bypassed entirely, since field-level errors have already been reported to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are Both State Code AND Zip Code Individually Valid?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the account update screen with a State Code and/or Zip Code value, AND at least one of those fields has already failed its individual field-level validation (i.e., State Code is not a valid 2-character alphabetic US state code, OR Zip Code is not a valid 5-digit non-zero numeric value)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether to perform the State and Zip Code cross-validation check
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips the State-Zip cross-validation entirely and does not generate any additional cross-validation error message, since field-level errors for State Code and/or Zip Code have already been flagged

rules.rule_name: Proceed to State-Zip Cross-Validation When Both Fields Are Individually Valid
rules.rule_description: The State and Zip Code cross-validation is only triggered when both the State Code and the Zip Code have each independently passed their own field-level validations. This ensures the cross-validation operates only on clean, well-formed input values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are Both State Code AND Zip Code Individually Valid?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has submitted the account update screen with a State Code and a Zip Code value, AND the State Code has passed individual validation (is a valid 2-character alphabetic US state code), AND the Zip Code has passed individual validation (is a valid 5-digit non-zero numeric value)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether to perform the State and Zip Code cross-validation check
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system proceeds to execute the State and Zip Code cross-validation by combining the State Code with the first 2 digits of the Zip Code and checking the combination against USPS-based rules

rules.rule_name: Combine State Code and Zip Code Prefix for Cross-Validation Lookup
rules.rule_description: To perform the State and Zip Code cross-validation, the system constructs a composite lookup key by concatenating the 2-character State Code with the first 2 digits of the 5-digit Zip Code. This combined 4-character value is then used to look up whether the zip code prefix is geographically consistent with the given state according to USPS-based rules.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Combine State Code with First 2 Digits of Zip Code into single lookup value

acceptance_criteria.Given: Both the State Code (2-character alphabetic, e.g., 'NY') and the Zip Code (5-digit numeric, e.g., '10001') have individually passed their field-level validations
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the cross-validation lookup
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system concatenates the full State Code (2 characters) with the first 2 digits of the Zip Code (e.g., '10') to form a single 4-character composite lookup value (e.g., 'NY10'), which is then used to check against the USPS-based State and Zip Code combination rules

rules.rule_name: Validate State and Zip Code Prefix Combination Against USPS-Based Rules
rules.rule_description: After constructing the composite State Code and Zip Code prefix lookup value, the system validates it against a predefined table of valid USPS-based State and Zip Code prefix combinations. This ensures that the zip code entered is geographically consistent with the state provided — for example, a zip code starting with '10' is valid for New York ('NY') but not for California ('CA').
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is the State + Zip Prefix Combination Valid per USPS-Based Rules?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has constructed a composite lookup value by combining the State Code with the first 2 digits of the Zip Code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system checks the composite value against the USPS-based valid State and Zip Code prefix combination table
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the combination is found in the valid combinations table, both the State Code and Zip Code are considered geographically consistent and the cross-validation passes with no error generated; If the combination is NOT found in the valid combinations table, the system marks both the State Code field and the Zip Code field as invalid, sets the error message to 'Invalid zip code for state', and flags the overall input as containing an error

rules.rule_name: Mark Both State and Zip Fields Invalid on Cross-Validation Failure
rules.rule_description: When the State Code and Zip Code prefix combination fails the USPS-based cross-validation, both fields are simultaneously marked as invalid. This dual-field invalidation signals to the user that the error is a geographic inconsistency between the two fields, not an error in either field individually. Both fields will be highlighted in red on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Both State Code AND Zip Code Fields as Invalid - Highlight in Red

acceptance_criteria.Given: The State Code and Zip Code have each individually passed their own field-level validations, AND the system has determined that the combination of the State Code and the first 2 digits of the Zip Code does not match any valid USPS-based State and Zip Code prefix combination
acceptance_criteria.When: The system processes the cross-validation failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system simultaneously marks the State Code field as invalid (FLG-STATE-NOT-OK), marks the Zip Code field as invalid (FLG-ZIPCODE-NOT-OK), sets the overall input error flag to indicate the screen contains errors, and sets the error message to 'Invalid zip code for state' — both fields will be highlighted in red on the screen when re-displayed to the user

rules.rule_name: Set Error Message for Invalid State and Zip Code Combination
rules.rule_description: When the State and Zip Code cross-validation fails, a specific business error message is generated to inform the user that the zip code entered is not valid for the state they have specified. The message is only set if no prior error message has already been recorded for this screen interaction, ensuring the first error encountered is the one displayed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Set Error Message: 'Invalid zip code for state'

acceptance_criteria.Given: The State Code and Zip Code cross-validation has failed because the combination of the State Code and the first 2 digits of the Zip Code is not a valid USPS-based combination, AND no prior error message has been set during this screen interaction (the error message field is currently empty)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets the error message for the cross-validation failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system sets the error message to exactly 'Invalid zip code for state', which will be displayed in the error message area of the account update screen; if a prior error message was already set from an earlier validation failure in the same screen interaction, the message is not overwritten and the existing message is preserved

rules.rule_name: City Field Must Be Supplied
rules.rule_description: Validates that the City field is not left blank or empty when a user submits account/customer update details. City is a mandatory field and must contain a value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is City Field Blank or Empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details, and the City field (mapped from customer address line 3) is available for editing with a maximum length of 50 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form with the City field left blank, containing only spaces, containing only low-values, or where the trimmed length of the City value equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The City field is marked as invalid with a blank indicator, an input error flag is set for the overall form, and the error message 'City must be supplied.' is recorded as the return message (only if no prior error message has already been set), and processing of the City field ends immediately

rules.rule_name: City Field Must Contain Alphabetic Characters Only
rules.rule_description: Validates that the City field, when supplied, contains only alphabetic characters and spaces. Numeric digits, special characters, or any non-alphabetic characters are not permitted in the City field.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does City Contain Only Alphabetic Characters and Spaces?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the City field has been supplied with a non-blank value of up to 50 characters, and the mandatory presence check has already passed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system inspects each character in the City field by converting all valid alphabetic characters (A–Z, a–z) and spaces to spaces, and then checks if any non-space characters remain after the conversion — meaning non-alphabetic characters were present in the original input
acceptance_criteria.Then: If non-alphabetic characters are found (i.e., the trimmed result of the converted field is not empty/zero length), the City field is marked as invalid with a not-ok indicator, an input error flag is set for the overall form, and the error message 'City can have alphabets only.' is recorded as the return message (only if no prior error message has already been set), and processing of the City field ends immediately

rules.rule_name: City Field Marked as Valid When All Checks Pass
rules.rule_description: When the City field passes both the mandatory presence check and the alphabetic-only character check, the City field is confirmed as valid and no error is raised.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark City as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the City field has been supplied with a non-blank value of up to 50 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The City field is non-blank AND all characters in the City field are alphabetic characters or spaces (no numeric or special characters present)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The City field is marked as valid with a valid indicator flag, no input error is set for the City field, and no error message is generated for City — allowing the overall form submission to proceed past the City validation step

rules.rule_name: Country Code Mandatory Supply Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Country Code field is not left blank or empty when a user submits account/customer update details. The Country Code is a required field and must contain a value.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Country Code blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and has fetched account details, and changes have been detected requiring full field validation
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the screen with the Country Code field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful characters after trimming
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Country Code field is marked as invalid with a blank flag, an input error is raised, the error message 'Country must be supplied.' is set (only if no prior error message has already been recorded), and the Country Code validation ends without proceeding to the alphabetic character check

rules.rule_name: Country Code Alphabetic Characters Only Validation
rules.rule_description: Validates that the Country Code field, when supplied, contains only alphabetic characters (A–Z, a–z). No numeric digits or special characters are permitted in the Country Code.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Does Country Code contain only alphabetic characters?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen, the Country Code field has been supplied with a non-blank value, and the mandatory supply check has passed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system inspects the Country Code value by converting all valid alphabetic characters to spaces and checks whether any non-alphabetic characters remain after the conversion
acceptance_criteria.Then: If non-alphabetic characters are found (i.e., the trimmed result is not empty after removing all alphabetic characters), the Country Code is marked as invalid, an input error is raised, and the error message 'Country can have alphabets only.' is set (only if no prior error message has already been recorded); if all characters are alphabetic, the Country Code is marked as valid

rules.rule_name: Country Code Field Length Constraint
rules.rule_description: Defines the expected length of the Country Code field. The Country Code must be exactly 3 characters in length when submitted for validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Receive Country Code entered by user

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is on the Account Update screen and is entering or modifying the Country Code for the customer's address
acceptance_criteria.When: The Country Code value is received from the screen input and prepared for validation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The validation is applied to exactly the first 3 characters of the Country Code field; the field label 'Country' is used in all associated error messages

rules.rule_name: Country Code Validation Result Stored for Screen Processing
rules.rule_description: After Country Code validation completes, the resulting validation status flags are stored so that the screen display logic can use them to determine field highlighting and cursor positioning.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Country Code as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Country Code field has completed its validation process (either passed or failed)
acceptance_criteria.When: The validation routine for alphabetic required fields returns its result flags
acceptance_criteria.Then: The validation outcome flags (valid, blank, or not-ok) are transferred to the Country Code-specific flag area (WS-EDIT-COUNTRY-FLGS) so that subsequent screen attribute setup can correctly highlight the field in red or mark it with an asterisk if invalid

rules.rule_name: Country Code Error Screen Highlighting
rules.rule_description: When the Country Code field fails validation (either blank or contains non-alphabetic characters), the field is visually highlighted in red on the screen to alert the user. If the field was left blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed in the field to indicate it requires input.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End: Validation Failed - Field highlighted red on screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Country Code validation has failed (field is either blank or contains non-alphabetic characters) and the program is in re-entry mode (the screen has been previously submitted)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen attributes are being set up for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Country Code field is highlighted in red on the screen; additionally, if the failure reason is that the field was blank, an asterisk '*' is placed in the Country Code output field as a visual prompt to the user that the field must be filled in

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Is Optional When All Parts Are Blank
rules.rule_description: Both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2 are optional fields. If all three parts (Area Code, Prefix, and Line Number) of a phone number are blank or empty, the phone number is considered not provided and is automatically marked as valid without any further validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Are ALL three parts of Phone Number 1 blank or empty? / Are ALL three parts of Phone Number 2 blank or empty?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating account and customer information on the Account Update screen, and both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2 fields are available for input
acceptance_criteria.When: All three parts of a phone number (Area Code, Prefix, and Line Number) are left blank or empty for Phone Number 1 or Phone Number 2
acceptance_criteria.Then: The phone number is treated as not provided, marked as valid, and no validation errors are raised for that phone number; processing continues to the next validation

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Area Code Must Be Supplied When Phone Number Is Partially Entered
rules.rule_description: If at least one part of a phone number has been entered (making it a partial entry), the Area Code portion is mandatory and must be provided. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Area Code supplied? / ERROR: Area Code must be supplied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is entering a phone number on the Account Update screen, and at least one part of the phone number (Prefix or Line Number) has been entered, making it a partial entry
acceptance_criteria.When: The Area Code field is left blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Area Code field is flagged as blank, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Area code must be supplied.' is displayed; validation continues to check the Prefix

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Area Code Must Be a 3-Digit Numeric Value
rules.rule_description: When an Area Code is supplied for a phone number, it must consist entirely of numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not permitted in the Area Code. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Area Code a 3-digit number? / ERROR: Area Code must be a 3-digit number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied an Area Code for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Area Code contains non-numeric characters (letters, symbols, or special characters)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Area Code field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Area code must be A 3 digit number.' is displayed; validation continues to check the Prefix

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Area Code Must Be Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: When an Area Code is supplied and is numeric, it must not be zero. An Area Code of all zeros is not a valid phone area code. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Area Code non-zero? / ERROR: Area Code cannot be zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied a numeric Area Code for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric value of the Area Code equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Area Code field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Area code cannot be zero' is displayed; validation continues to check the Prefix

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Area Code Must Be a Valid North America General Purpose Area Code
rules.rule_description: When an Area Code is supplied, numeric, and non-zero, it must be a recognized valid North America general purpose area code. Special-purpose, reserved, or non-existent area codes are not accepted. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Area Code a valid North America General Purpose Area Code? / ERROR: Not a valid North America general purpose area code

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied a numeric, non-zero Area Code for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Area Code does not match any valid North America general purpose area code in the reference list
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Area Code field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Not valid North America general purpose area code' is displayed; validation continues to check the Prefix

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Prefix Must Be Supplied When Phone Number Is Partially Entered
rules.rule_description: When a phone number has been partially entered (at least one part provided), the Prefix (middle 3 digits) is mandatory and must be provided. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2, and is checked regardless of whether the Area Code passed or failed validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Prefix supplied? / ERROR: Prefix must be supplied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is entering a phone number on the Account Update screen, and at least one part of the phone number has been entered
acceptance_criteria.When: The Prefix field is left blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Prefix field is flagged as blank, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Prefix code must be supplied.' is displayed; validation continues to check the Line Number

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Prefix Must Be a 3-Digit Numeric Value
rules.rule_description: When a Prefix is supplied for a phone number, it must consist entirely of numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not permitted in the Prefix. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Prefix a 3-digit number? / ERROR: Prefix must be a 3-digit number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied a Prefix for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Prefix contains non-numeric characters (letters, symbols, or special characters)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Prefix field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Prefix code must be A 3 digit number.' is displayed; validation continues to check the Line Number

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Prefix Must Be Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: When a Prefix is supplied and is numeric, it must not be zero. A Prefix of all zeros is not a valid phone prefix. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Prefix non-zero? / ERROR: Prefix cannot be zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied a numeric Prefix for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric value of the Prefix equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Prefix field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Prefix code cannot be zero' is displayed; validation continues to check the Line Number

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Line Number Must Be Supplied When Phone Number Is Partially Entered
rules.rule_description: When a phone number has been partially entered (at least one part provided), the Line Number (last 4 digits) is mandatory and must be provided. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2, and is checked regardless of whether the Area Code or Prefix passed or failed validation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Line Number supplied? / ERROR: Line Number must be supplied

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is entering a phone number on the Account Update screen, and at least one part of the phone number has been entered
acceptance_criteria.When: The Line Number field is left blank or empty
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Line Number field is flagged as blank, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Line number code must be supplied.' is displayed; phone number validation ends and processing moves to the next phone number or next validation

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Line Number Must Be a 4-Digit Numeric Value
rules.rule_description: When a Line Number is supplied for a phone number, it must consist entirely of numeric digits. Non-numeric characters are not permitted in the Line Number. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Line Number a 4-digit number? / ERROR: Line Number must be a 4-digit number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied a Line Number for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Line Number contains non-numeric characters (letters, symbols, or special characters)
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Line Number field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Line number code must be A 4 digit number.' is displayed; phone number validation ends and processing moves to the next phone number or next validation

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Line Number Must Be Non-Zero
rules.rule_description: When a Line Number is supplied and is numeric, it must not be zero. A Line Number of all zeros is not a valid phone line number. This rule applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Line Number non-zero? / ERROR: Line Number cannot be zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has supplied a numeric Line Number for a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric value of the Line Number equals zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: An input error is raised, the Line Number field is flagged as invalid, and the error message '[Phone Number field name]: Line number code cannot be zero' is displayed; phone number validation ends and processing moves to the next phone number or next validation

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Is Fully Valid When All Three Parts Pass All Checks
rules.rule_description: A phone number is considered fully valid only when all three parts — Area Code, Prefix, and Line Number — have each individually passed all their respective validation checks (supplied, numeric, non-zero, and for Area Code also a valid North America general purpose code). This applies to both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Phone Number 1 Fully Valid / Phone Number 2 Fully Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has entered all three parts of a phone number on the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The Area Code is supplied, numeric, non-zero, and a valid North America general purpose area code; AND the Prefix is supplied, numeric, and non-zero; AND the Line Number is supplied, numeric, and non-zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The phone number is marked as fully valid with no errors raised, and processing continues to validate the next phone number or the next field

rules.rule_name: Phone Number Validation Is Invoked Sequentially for Both Phone Numbers
rules.rule_description: The phone number validation process is applied to both Phone Number 1 (primary) and Phone Number 2 (secondary) in sequence. Phone Number 1 is validated first, and regardless of its outcome (valid, optional, or errors), Phone Number 2 is always validated next using the same set of rules.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Check Phone Number 1 Area Code + Prefix + Line Number / Check Phone Number 2 Area Code + Prefix + Line Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is submitting account and customer updates on the Account Update screen, and both Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2 fields are present
acceptance_criteria.When: The phone number validation process is triggered as part of the full field validation sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: Phone Number 1 is validated first (Area Code, then Prefix, then Line Number), and upon completion — whether valid, optional, or containing errors — Phone Number 2 is validated next using the identical validation rules; validation results for each phone number are stored independently as Phone Number 1 flags and Phone Number 2 flags respectively

rules.rule_name: EFT Account ID - Mandatory Field Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the EFT Account ID field has been supplied by the user and is not left blank or empty before any further validation is performed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is EFT Account ID blank or not supplied?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating customer account details and the EFT Account ID field is part of the update form with a required length of 10 characters
acceptance_criteria.When: The user submits the form with the EFT Account ID field left blank, containing only spaces, or containing no meaningful value (empty after trimming)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the EFT Account ID field as invalid with a blank error flag, sets the overall input to an error state, and displays the error message 'EFT Account Id must be supplied.' — no further validation of the EFT Account ID is performed for this submission

rules.rule_name: EFT Account ID - Numeric Format Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the EFT Account ID, when supplied, consists entirely of numeric digits with a length of 10 characters, ensuring no alphabetic or special characters are present.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is EFT Account ID all numeric? 10 digits

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating customer account details and has supplied a value in the EFT Account ID field (10-character field, not blank)
acceptance_criteria.When: The submitted EFT Account ID value contains one or more non-numeric characters (letters, symbols, or mixed content)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the EFT Account ID field as invalid with a not-ok error flag, sets the overall input to an error state, and displays the error message 'EFT Account Id must be all numeric.' — no further validation of the EFT Account ID is performed for this submission

rules.rule_name: EFT Account ID - Non-Zero Value Check
rules.rule_description: Validates that the EFT Account ID, after passing the numeric format check, contains a meaningful non-zero value, preventing the submission of an all-zeros EFT Account ID.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is EFT Account ID value zero?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating customer account details and has supplied a value in the EFT Account ID field that has already passed the mandatory and numeric format checks
acceptance_criteria.When: The numeric value of the submitted EFT Account ID evaluates to zero (e.g., '0000000000')
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the EFT Account ID field as invalid with a not-ok error flag, sets the overall input to an error state, and displays the error message 'EFT Account Id must not be zero.' — the EFT Account ID is not accepted

rules.rule_name: EFT Account ID - Successful Validation
rules.rule_description: Confirms that the EFT Account ID has passed all validation checks — it is supplied, all numeric, and non-zero — and marks it as valid so the update process can proceed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark EFT Account ID as Valid

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user is updating customer account details and has supplied a value in the EFT Account ID field
acceptance_criteria.When: The EFT Account ID is not blank, consists entirely of numeric digits across its 10-character length, and its numeric value is greater than zero
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system marks the EFT Account ID field as valid, clears any error flags for this field, and allows the overall account update validation process to continue to the next field
