rules.rule_name: Initialize Customer Update Record Before Population
rules.rule_description: Before populating the customer update record with new values, all fields in the record must be cleared to ensure no residual or stale data from a previous operation is carried forward into the update.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialize Customer Update Record
Clear all fields in the
customer update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A confirmed account and customer update has been requested by the user after passing all validations, and the system is preparing to write the new customer data to the Customer Master file
acceptance_criteria.When: The system begins building the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: All fields in the customer update record (CUST-UPDATE-RECORD) are cleared and reset to their initial empty state before any new values are copied into it

rules.rule_name: Set Customer ID in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The Customer ID that was originally fetched and associated with the account must be carried forward unchanged into the customer update record to ensure the correct customer record is updated in the Customer Master file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Customer ID
Copy customer ID
to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized and the new customer ID (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ID) is available from the validated input
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Customer ID field (CUST-UPDATE-ID) in the update record is set to the value of the new customer ID (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ID)

rules.rule_name: Set Customer Name Fields in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's full name — comprising first name, middle name, and last name — as entered and validated by the user must be written to the customer update record. All three name components are individually copied to their respective fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Customer Name Fields
Copy first name, middle name,
and last name to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated new first name (ACUP-NEW-CUST-FIRST-NAME), middle name (ACUP-NEW-CUST-MIDDLE-NAME), and last name (ACUP-NEW-CUST-LAST-NAME) are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the name fields in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The first name field (CUST-UPDATE-FIRST-NAME) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-FIRST-NAME, the middle name field (CUST-UPDATE-MIDDLE-NAME) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-MIDDLE-NAME, and the last name field (CUST-UPDATE-LAST-NAME) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-LAST-NAME

rules.rule_name: Set Customer Address Fields in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's address details — comprising address line 1, address line 2, and city (stored as address line 3) — as entered and validated by the user must be written to the customer update record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Address Fields
Copy address line 1, address line 2,
and city to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated new address line 1 (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-1), address line 2 (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-2), and city/address line 3 (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-3) are available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the address fields in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The address line 1 field (CUST-UPDATE-ADDR-LINE-1) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-1, the address line 2 field (CUST-UPDATE-ADDR-LINE-2) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-2, and the city field (CUST-UPDATE-ADDR-LINE-3) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-LINE-3

rules.rule_name: Set State and Zip Code in Update Record — Country Code is Read-Only and Not Updated
rules.rule_description: The customer's state code and zip code as entered and validated by the user are written to the customer update record. The country code field is protected on the screen and is not editable by the user; therefore, it is not included in the update record population.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set State, Country and Zip Code
Copy state code and zip code
to update record
Note: Country code is read-only, not updated

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated new state code (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD) and zip code (ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-ZIP) are available; the country code field is protected on the screen and cannot be modified by the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the geographic location fields in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The state code field (CUST-UPDATE-ADDR-STATE-CD) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD, the zip code field (CUST-UPDATE-ADDR-ZIP) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-ZIP, and the country code field (CUST-UPDATE-ADDR-COUNTRY-CD) is set to ACUP-NEW-CUST-ADDR-COUNTRY-CD as carried from the validated input

rules.rule_name: Format and Set Primary Phone Number in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The primary phone number is entered by the user in three separate parts — area code (3 digits), prefix (3 digits), and line number (4 digits). Before storing in the Customer Master file, these three parts must be combined and formatted into the standard North American phone number format: (NNN)NNN-NNNN.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Primary Phone Number
Build phone number 1 in format
'NNN'NNN-NNNN from three separate parts:
Area Code, Prefix, and Line Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated primary phone number parts are available: area code (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1A), prefix (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1B), and line number (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1C)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats and populates the primary phone number field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The primary phone number field (CUST-UPDATE-PHONE-NUM-1) is built by concatenating: opening parenthesis '(', area code (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1A), closing parenthesis ')', prefix (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1B), hyphen '-', and line number (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1C), resulting in the format (NNN)NNN-NNNN

rules.rule_name: Format and Set Secondary Phone Number in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The secondary phone number is entered by the user in three separate parts — area code (3 digits), prefix (3 digits), and line number (4 digits). Before storing in the Customer Master file, these three parts must be combined and formatted into the standard North American phone number format: (NNN)NNN-NNNN.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Secondary Phone Number
Build phone number 2 in format
'NNN'NNN-NNNN from three separate parts:
Area Code, Prefix, and Line Number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated secondary phone number parts are available: area code (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2A), prefix (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2B), and line number (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2C)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats and populates the secondary phone number field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The secondary phone number field (CUST-UPDATE-PHONE-NUM-2) is built by concatenating: opening parenthesis '(', area code (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2A), closing parenthesis ')', prefix (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2B), hyphen '-', and line number (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2C), resulting in the format (NNN)NNN-NNNN

rules.rule_name: Set Social Security Number in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's Social Security Number, which was validated in three separate parts (first 3 digits, 4th and 5th digits, last 4 digits), is stored as a combined value and must be copied to the customer update record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Social Security Number
Copy combined SSN
to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated combined Social Security Number (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN) is available from the validated input
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the SSN field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The SSN field (CUST-UPDATE-SSN) in the update record is set to the combined SSN value (ACUP-NEW-CUST-SSN)

rules.rule_name: Set Government Issued ID in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's government-issued identification number as entered by the user must be copied to the customer update record for storage in the Customer Master file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Government Issued ID
Copy government issued ID
to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the new government issued ID (ACUP-NEW-CUST-GOVT-ISSUED-ID) is available from the validated input
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the government issued ID field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The government issued ID field (CUST-UPDATE-GOVT-ISSUED-ID) in the update record is set to the value of ACUP-NEW-CUST-GOVT-ISSUED-ID

rules.rule_name: Format and Set Date of Birth in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's date of birth is entered by the user in three separate parts — year (4 digits), month (2 digits), and day (2 digits). Before storing in the Customer Master file, these three parts must be combined and formatted into the standard date format: YYYY-MM-DD.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Date of Birth
Build date of birth in format
YYYY-MM-DD from three separate parts:
Year, Month, and Day

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated date of birth parts are available: year (ACUP-NEW-CUST-DOB-YEAR), month (ACUP-NEW-CUST-DOB-MON), and day (ACUP-NEW-CUST-DOB-DAY)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats and populates the date of birth field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The date of birth field (CUST-UPDATE-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD) is built by concatenating: year (ACUP-NEW-CUST-DOB-YEAR), hyphen '-', month (ACUP-NEW-CUST-DOB-MON), hyphen '-', and day (ACUP-NEW-CUST-DOB-DAY), resulting in the format YYYY-MM-DD

rules.rule_name: Set EFT Account ID in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) account identifier, which links the customer to their bank account for electronic payments, must be copied to the customer update record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set EFT Account ID
Copy Electronic Funds Transfer
account ID to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated new EFT account ID (ACUP-NEW-CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID) is available from the validated input
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the EFT account ID field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The EFT account ID field (CUST-UPDATE-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID) in the update record is set to the value of ACUP-NEW-CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID

rules.rule_name: Set Primary Card Holder Indicator in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The primary card holder indicator flag, which designates whether the customer is the primary holder of the credit card (Y) or not (N), must be copied to the customer update record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Primary Card Holder Indicator
Copy primary card holder flag
Y or N to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated new primary card holder indicator (ACUP-NEW-CUST-PRI-HOLDER-IND) with a value of 'Y' or 'N' is available from the validated input
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the primary card holder indicator field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The primary card holder indicator field (CUST-UPDATE-PRI-CARD-IND) in the update record is set to the value of ACUP-NEW-CUST-PRI-HOLDER-IND, which is either 'Y' (is primary holder) or 'N' (is not primary holder)

rules.rule_name: Set FICO Credit Score in Update Record
rules.rule_description: The customer's FICO credit score, which is a 3-digit numeric value between 300 and 850 representing the customer's creditworthiness, must be copied to the customer update record for storage in the Customer Master file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set FICO Credit Score
Copy FICO credit score
to update record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been initialized, and the validated new FICO credit score (ACUP-NEW-CUST-FICO-SCORE) is available from the validated input with a value between 300 and 850
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the FICO credit score field in the customer update record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The FICO credit score field (CUST-UPDATE-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE) in the update record is set to the value of ACUP-NEW-CUST-FICO-SCORE

rules.rule_name: Assemble Account Update Record with All New Field Values
rules.rule_description: Before saving to the Account Master File, a complete account update record must be assembled by populating all required fields with the user-entered and validated new values. Date fields (Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date) must be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD before being stored.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Account Record to Account Master File with all new values: Account ID, Active Status, Current Balance, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date, Group ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A user has confirmed account changes that have passed all validations, both the Account and Customer records have been successfully locked for update, and no concurrent modifications have been detected
acceptance_criteria.When: The system assembles the account update record prior to writing it to the Account Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The account update record must be initialized (cleared) and then populated with the following new values: Account ID, Active Status, Current Balance, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Cycle Credit amount, Current Cycle Debit amount, Open Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, Expiry Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, Reissue Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, and Group ID — all sourced from the user-entered and validated new data

rules.rule_name: Format Account Date Fields as YYYY-MM-DD Before Saving
rules.rule_description: The three account date fields — Open Date, Expiry Date, and Reissue Date — are entered by the user as separate Year, Month, and Day components. Before writing to the Account Master File, each date must be assembled into a single string in the standard YYYY-MM-DD format with hyphen separators.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Account Record to Account Master File with all new values: Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date

acceptance_criteria.Given: The user has entered valid Year, Month, and Day values separately for the Open Date, Expiry Date, and Reissue Date fields
acceptance_criteria.When: The system assembles the account update record for saving
acceptance_criteria.Then: Each date field must be concatenated into a single value in the format YYYY-MM-DD (Year + '-' + Month + '-' + Day) for Open Date, Expiry Date, and Reissue Date respectively before being stored in the account update record

rules.rule_name: Write Updated Account Record to Account Master File
rules.rule_description: Once the account update record has been fully assembled with all new values, the system must write (rewrite) the updated record to the Account Master File (ACCTDAT) to persist the changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Account Record to Account Master File with all new values

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update record has been fully assembled with all new field values including formatted dates, and the account record is currently locked for update
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to save the updated account record to the Account Master File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must write the complete assembled account update record to the Account Master File, replacing the previously locked record

rules.rule_name: Determine Outcome After Account Record Save Attempt
rules.rule_description: After attempting to write the updated account record to the Account Master File, the system must evaluate whether the save was successful. A successful save allows processing to continue to the customer record update. A failed save halts all further update processing immediately.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Record Saved Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated account record to the Account Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the result of the account record save operation
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the account record was saved successfully, the system must proceed to save the customer record changes; if the account record save failed for any reason, the system must mark the overall update as failed (Update Failed status) and immediately stop all further update processing — no attempt is made to save customer record changes

rules.rule_name: Mark Update as Failed When Account Record Cannot Be Saved
rules.rule_description: If the account record cannot be successfully written to the Account Master File, the system must flag the entire update operation as failed. This prevents any partial updates and ensures the user is informed that their account changes were not saved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Update as Failed - Account changes could not be saved

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated account record to the Account Master File and the save operation did not complete successfully
acceptance_criteria.When: The system detects that the account record save has failed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the update status to 'Update Failed' (LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED), immediately exit the update processing routine without attempting to save any customer record changes, and return control so that the screen can display an appropriate failure message to the user

rules.rule_name: Proceed to Customer Record Save After Successful Account Save
rules.rule_description: A successful save of the account record to the Account Master File is a prerequisite for proceeding to save the associated customer record changes. The two updates are treated as a sequential dependent process — customer changes are only attempted if the account changes were saved successfully.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Proceed to Save Customer Changes

acceptance_criteria.Given: The updated account record has been successfully written to the Account Master File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the account record save was successful
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must continue processing and proceed to assemble and save the updated customer record to the Customer Master File, maintaining the integrity of the combined account and customer update operation

key_functionalities.title: Save Customer Changes to Database
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Begin Save Customer Changes])
    WRITECUST[Write Updated Customer Record\nto Customer Master File\nwith all new values:\nname, address, phone numbers,\nSSN, DOB, EFT account ID,\nprimary holder indicator, FICO score]
    CUSTDAT_WRITE[(CUSTDAT\nCustomer Master File)]
    SAVECUSTOK{Customer Record\nSaved Successfully?}
    ROLLBACK[Roll Back Account Update\nUndo the previously saved\naccount record changes\nto maintain data consistency]
    UPDATEFAILED[Mark Update as Failed\nSet status to indicate\nboth account and customer\nupdates have been rolled back]
    UPDATESUCCESS[Mark Update as Successful\nBoth account and customer\nrecords saved successfully]
    END([End Save Customer Changes])
    START --> WRITECUST
    WRITECUST --> CUSTDAT_WRITE
    CUSTDAT_WRITE -.->|Write Customer Record| WRITECUST
    WRITECUST --> SAVECUSTOK
    SAVECUSTOK -->|Yes - Save Successful| UPDATESUCCESS
    SAVECUSTOK -->|No - Save Failed| ROLLBACK
    ROLLBACK --> UPDATEFAILED
    UPDATEFAILED --> END
    UPDATESUCCESS --> END

rules.rule_name: Build Customer Update Record with All New Values
rules.rule_description: Before saving to the Customer Master file, the system assembles the complete customer update record by populating all editable customer fields with the newly entered values, including formatted phone numbers and date of birth.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Customer Record to Customer Master File with all new values: name, address, phone numbers, SSN, DOB, EFT account ID, primary holder indicator, FICO score

acceptance_criteria.Given: A confirmed account update has passed all validations and the account record has already been successfully saved, and the system has locked the customer record for update
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the customer update record to be written to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The customer update record must be populated with all of the following new values: Customer ID, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City (Address Line 3), State Code, Country Code, Zip Code; Phone Number 1 formatted as (AAA)PPP-LLLL using the three entered parts (area code, prefix, line number); Phone Number 2 formatted as (AAA)PPP-LLLL using the three entered parts; SSN, Government Issued ID, Date of Birth formatted as YYYY-MM-DD using the three entered parts (year, month, day); EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and FICO Credit Score

rules.rule_name: Save Updated Customer Record to Customer Master File
rules.rule_description: The system writes the fully assembled customer update record to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT) as the final step of the account update process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Updated Customer Record to Customer Master File with all new values: name, address, phone numbers, SSN, DOB, EFT account ID, primary holder indicator, FICO score

acceptance_criteria.Given: The customer update record has been fully assembled with all new values and the customer record is locked for update in the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system attempts to write (rewrite) the updated customer record to the Customer Master file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The customer record in the Customer Master file is updated with all new values for the customer; the system then evaluates whether the write operation completed successfully to determine the next course of action

rules.rule_name: Confirm Successful Customer Record Save
rules.rule_description: When the customer record is saved successfully to the Customer Master file, the overall update is marked as complete and successful, indicating that both the account and customer records have been persisted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Update as Successful - Both account and customer records saved successfully

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated customer record to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation to the Customer Master file completes successfully (normal response received)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The update status is set to 'Changes Okayed and Done' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE), indicating that both the account record and the customer record have been successfully saved; the screen will subsequently display a success confirmation message to the user

rules.rule_name: Roll Back Account Update When Customer Save Fails
rules.rule_description: If the customer record cannot be saved to the Customer Master file after the account record has already been written, the system must roll back the account record update to ensure both files remain consistent with each other.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Roll Back Account Update - Undo the previously saved account record changes to maintain data consistency

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account record has already been successfully written to the Account Master file (ACCTDAT) as part of the current update transaction, and the system has attempted to write the updated customer record to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
acceptance_criteria.When: The write operation to the Customer Master file fails (a non-normal response is received)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system issues a transaction rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to undo the previously saved account record changes, ensuring that the Account Master file is restored to its state before the update began, thereby maintaining data consistency between the Account Master file and the Customer Master file

rules.rule_name: Mark Update as Failed After Customer Save Failure and Rollback
rules.rule_description: After a customer record save failure and subsequent rollback of the account update, the overall update status is marked as failed so the user is informed that neither the account nor the customer changes were saved.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Mark Update as Failed - Set status to indicate both account and customer updates have been rolled back

acceptance_criteria.Given: The write operation to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT) has failed and the system has issued a rollback to undo the account record update
acceptance_criteria.When: The rollback of the account update completes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The update status is set to 'Locked But Update Failed' (LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED), indicating that the update process failed and neither the account record nor the customer record changes have been persisted; the screen will subsequently display a failure message to the user

key_functionalities.title: Screen Initialization
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    A([Start Screen Initialization])
    B[Clear all screen output fields\nReset screen to blank state]

    E[Set Transaction ID\nDisplay current transaction identifier\nin screen header]

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H --> I
    I --> J
    J --> K

rules.rule_name: Clear Screen Output Fields Before Initialization
rules.rule_description: Before populating any screen fields, all output fields on the Account Update screen must be reset to blank/empty state to ensure no residual data from a previous display is shown to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Clear all screen output fields
Reset screen to blank state

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is about to be prepared for display to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: Screen initialization begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: All output fields on the Account Update screen (CACTUPAO) are cleared and reset to blank/empty values, ensuring no previously displayed data remains visible

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time
rules.rule_description: The system must obtain the current date and time from the operating environment to display accurate timestamp information in the screen header for the user's reference.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Retrieve Current Date and Time
from System

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized
acceptance_criteria.When: The system retrieves the current date and time
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current date and time are obtained from the system and stored in the working storage date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA), making both date components (year, month, day) and time components (hours, minutes, seconds) available for formatting and display

rules.rule_name: Display Application Title Lines in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The Account Update screen header must display the standard application title lines as defined by the application's title constants, providing consistent branding and screen identification across the application.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Screen Titles
Move application title lines
to screen header area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized and application title constants (CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02) are defined
acceptance_criteria.When: Screen titles are set during initialization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The first application title line (CCDA-TITLE01) is placed in the first title field (TITLE01O) of the screen, and the second application title line (CCDA-TITLE02) is placed in the second title field (TITLE02O) of the screen

rules.rule_name: Display Current Transaction Identifier in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display the transaction ID of the currently executing transaction, allowing users and support staff to identify which transaction is active on the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Transaction ID
Display current transaction identifier
in screen header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized and the current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) is defined
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction ID is set in the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) is displayed in the transaction name field (TRNNAMEO) of the Account Update screen header

rules.rule_name: Display Current Program Name in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The screen header must display the name of the currently executing program, enabling users and support staff to identify which program is generating the displayed screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Program Name
Display current program name
in screen header

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized and the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is defined
acceptance_criteria.When: The program name is set in the screen header
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is displayed in the program name field (PGMNAMEO) of the Account Update screen header

rules.rule_name: Format Current Date as MM/DD/YY for Screen Display
rules.rule_description: The current system date must be formatted into the MM/DD/YY display format by extracting the individual month, day, and 2-digit year components from the system date, so it can be presented in a user-friendly format on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Current Date
Extract Month, Day, and Year
and arrange as MM/DD/YY

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system date has been retrieved and stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA, containing separate year, month, and day components
acceptance_criteria.When: The current date is formatted for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The month component (WS-CURDATE-MONTH) is extracted into the MM position (WS-CURDATE-MM), the day component (WS-CURDATE-DAY) is extracted into the DD position (WS-CURDATE-DD), and only the last 2 digits of the year (positions 3 and 4 of WS-CURDATE-YEAR) are extracted into the YY position (WS-CURDATE-YY), resulting in a date formatted as MM/DD/YY in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

rules.rule_name: Display Formatted Date in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The formatted current date in MM/DD/YY format must be placed into the designated date display field on the Account Update screen header so users can see the current date while working with the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Formatted Date
Move formatted date
to screen date field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current date has been formatted into MM/DD/YY format and stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY
acceptance_criteria.When: The formatted date is placed on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The formatted date (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) is moved to the current date output field (CURDATEO) on the Account Update screen (CACTUPAO), making it visible to the user in the screen header

rules.rule_name: Format Current Time as HH:MM:SS for Screen Display
rules.rule_description: The current system time must be formatted into the HH:MM:SS display format by extracting the individual hours, minutes, and seconds components from the system time, so it can be presented in a user-friendly format on the screen header.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Current Time
Extract Hours, Minutes, and Seconds
and arrange as HH:MM:SS

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current system time has been retrieved as part of WS-CURDATE-DATA, containing separate hours, minutes, and seconds components
acceptance_criteria.When: The current time is formatted for screen display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The hours component (WS-CURTIME-HOURS) is extracted into the HH position (WS-CURTIME-HH), the minutes component (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE) is extracted into the MM position (WS-CURTIME-MM), and the seconds component (WS-CURTIME-SECOND) is extracted into the SS position (WS-CURTIME-SS), resulting in a time formatted as HH:MM:SS in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

rules.rule_name: Display Formatted Time in Screen Header
rules.rule_description: The formatted current time in HH:MM:SS format must be placed into the designated time display field on the Account Update screen header so users can see the current time while working with the screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Formatted Time
Move formatted time
to screen time field

acceptance_criteria.Given: The current time has been formatted into HH:MM:SS format and stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS
acceptance_criteria.When: The formatted time is placed on the screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The formatted time (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) is moved to the current time output field (CURTIMEO) on the Account Update screen (CACTUPAO), making it visible to the user in the screen header

rules.rule_name: Skip Data Field Population on Fresh Program Entry
rules.rule_description: When a user accesses the Account Update screen for the very first time in a session (fresh entry), the system bypasses all data field population logic and leaves the screen fields empty, ready for the user to enter a search account number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is this a Fresh Program Entry? → Yes - First Entry → Skip All Data Field Population / Leave Screen Fields Empty

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program is in a fresh entry state (first-time entry into the program, indicated by the program-enter flag being set)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether to populate screen data fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system skips all data field population routines entirely, leaving all account, customer, date, address, and contact fields empty on the screen, and proceeds directly to sending the blank screen to the user

rules.rule_name: Route Screen Display Based on Current Account Search State
rules.rule_description: For a returning user (not a fresh entry), the system evaluates the current screen state to determine which set of data values to display — blank initial values, original fetched values, or user-entered updated values.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No - Returning User → What is the Current Screen State?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for a returning user (not a fresh program entry) AND the Account ID field on screen is populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system routes display as follows: (1) If the screen state is 'Details Not Fetched' OR the Account ID value is zero, display the initial empty screen (blank all data fields); (2) If the screen state is 'Show Details', display the original values fetched from the account and customer master files; (3) If the screen state is 'Changes Made' (changes in progress), display the user-entered updated values; (4) For any other state, display the original fetched values as a default

rules.rule_name: Trigger Initial Empty Screen When No Account Has Been Searched
rules.rule_description: When a returning user has not yet performed an account search (details not fetched state) or the Account ID is zero, the system triggers the initial empty screen display, clearing all data fields to present a clean search interface.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Account Searched Yet or Account ID is Zero → 44: Display Initial Empty Screen

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for a returning user AND the current screen state is either 'Account Details Not Yet Fetched' OR the Account ID currently held is zero
acceptance_criteria.When: The system determines which display routine to invoke
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the initial empty screen display routine (3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES), which clears all account, customer, date, address, and contact data fields on the screen

rules.rule_name: Clear All Account Financial Fields on Initial Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all account financial and status fields are cleared to blank so the user sees an empty form ready for a new account search.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Account Fields: Active Status, Credit Limit, Current Balance, Cash Credit Limit, Cycle Credit, Cycle Debit

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following account fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Account Active Status, Credit Limit, Current Balance, Cash Credit Limit, Current Cycle Credit amount, and Current Cycle Debit amount

rules.rule_name: Clear All Date Fields on Initial Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all date-related fields for account open date, expiry date, and reissue date are cleared to blank.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Date Fields: Open Date Year/Month/Day, Expiry Date Year/Month/Day, Reissue Date Year/Month/Day

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following date fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Open Date Year, Open Date Month, Open Date Day, Expiry Date Year, Expiry Date Month, Expiry Date Day, Reissue Date Year, Reissue Date Month, and Reissue Date Day

rules.rule_name: Clear All Customer Identity Fields on Initial Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer identity fields including Customer ID, Social Security Number parts, FICO credit score, and date of birth are cleared to blank.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Customer Fields: Customer ID, SSN Parts 1-2-3, FICO Score, Date of Birth Year/Month/Day

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following customer identity fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Customer ID, SSN Part 1 (first 3 digits), SSN Part 2 (4th and 5th digits), SSN Part 3 (last 4 digits), FICO Credit Score, Date of Birth Year, Date of Birth Month, and Date of Birth Day

rules.rule_name: Clear All Customer Name Fields on Initial Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer name fields are cleared to blank so no previously viewed customer name data is visible.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Name Fields: First Name, Middle Name, Last Name

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following customer name fields are cleared to blank on the screen: First Name, Middle Name, and Last Name

rules.rule_name: Clear All Address and Group Fields on Initial Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer address fields and the account group identifier are cleared to blank.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Address Fields: Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State, Zip Code, Country, Group ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following address and grouping fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, Zip Code, Country Code, and Account Group ID

rules.rule_name: Clear All Contact and Identification Fields on Initial Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer contact fields including both phone numbers (each split into area code, prefix, and line number), government-issued ID, EFT account ID, and primary card holder indicator are cleared to blank.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Clear All Contact Fields: Phone Number 1 Area/Prefix/Line, Phone Number 2 Area/Prefix/Line, Government ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The following contact and identification fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Phone Number 1 Area Code, Phone Number 1 Prefix, Phone Number 1 Line Number, Phone Number 2 Area Code, Phone Number 2 Prefix, Phone Number 2 Line Number, Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, and Primary Card Holder Indicator

rules.rule_name: Protect All Fields and Activate Only Account ID for Input on Empty Screen
rules.rule_description: After all data fields are cleared for the initial empty screen, the system sets all screen fields to protected (read-only) and then specifically makes only the Account ID field editable, so the user can only enter an account number to initiate a search.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Screen Ready: All Data Fields Blank / Only Account ID Field Active for User Input

acceptance_criteria.Given: The initial empty screen display routine has cleared all data fields AND the current screen state is 'Account Details Not Yet Fetched'
acceptance_criteria.When: The system sets screen field protection attributes
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen fields (Account Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Cycle Credit, Cycle Debit, all date fields, all customer fields, all name fields, all address fields, all contact fields, Government ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and the information message area) are set to protected/read-only; AND the Account ID field alone is set to unprotected/editable so the user can enter an account number to search

key_functionalities.title: Display Original Account and Customer Data
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Display Original Account and Customer Data])
    CHECKACCT{Account Data\nFound in Master?}
    SHOWACCTSTATUS[Display Account Active Status]
    FORMATCURRBAL[Format Current Balance\nwith Commas and Decimals]
    FORMATCREDLIMIT[Format Credit Limit\nwith Commas and Decimals]
    FORMATCASHLIMIT[Format Cash Credit Limit\nwith Commas and Decimals]
    FORMATCYCCREDIT[Format Current Cycle Credit\nwith Commas and Decimals]
    FORMATCYCDEBIT[Format Current Cycle Debit\nwith Commas and Decimals]
    SHOWDATES[Display Account Dates:\nOpen Date Year / Month / Day\nExpiry Date Year / Month / Day\nReissue Date Year / Month / Day]
    SHOWGROUPID[Display Group ID]
    CHECKCUST{Customer Data\nFound in Master?}
    SHOWCUSTID[Display Customer ID]
    SHOWSSN[Display SSN in Three Parts:\nFirst 3 digits\nMiddle 2 digits\nLast 4 digits]
    SHOWFICO[Display FICO Credit Score]
    SHOWDOB[Display Date of Birth:\nYear / Month / Day]
    SHOWNAME[Display Customer Name:\nFirst Name\nMiddle Name\nLast Name]
    SHOWADDR[Display Customer Address:\nAddress Line 1\nAddress Line 2\nCity\nState\nZip Code\nCountry]
    SHOWPHONE[Display Phone Numbers:\nPhone 1 - Area Code / Prefix / Line Number\nPhone 2 - Area Code / Prefix / Line Number]
    SHOWOTHER[Display Other Customer Details:\nGovernment Issued ID\nEFT Account ID\nPrimary Card Holder Indicator]
    PROMPTCHANGES[Set Screen Message:\nPrompt User to Make Changes]
    END([End - Screen Ready for Display])

    START --> CHECKACCT
    CHECKACCT -->|Yes - Account Data Available| SHOWACCTSTATUS
    SHOWACCTSTATUS --> FORMATCURRBAL
    FORMATCURRBAL --> FORMATCREDLIMIT
    FORMATCREDLIMIT --> FORMATCASHLIMIT
    FORMATCASHLIMIT --> FORMATCYCCREDIT
    FORMATCYCCREDIT --> FORMATCYCDEBIT
    FORMATCYCDEBIT --> SHOWDATES
    SHOWDATES --> SHOWGROUPID
    SHOWGROUPID --> CHECKCUST
    CHECKACCT -->|No - Account Data Not Available| CHECKCUST
    CHECKCUST -->|Yes - Customer Data Available| SHOWCUSTID
    SHOWCUSTID --> SHOWSSN
    SHOWSSN --> SHOWFICO
    SHOWFICO --> SHOWDOB
    SHOWDOB --> SHOWNAME
    SHOWNAME --> SHOWADDR
    SHOWADDR --> SHOWPHONE
    SHOWPHONE --> SHOWOTHER
    SHOWOTHER --> PROMPTCHANGES
    CHECKCUST -->|No - Customer Data Not Available| PROMPTCHANGES
    PROMPTCHANGES --> END

rules.rule_name: Determine Eligibility to Display Account and Customer Data on Screen
rules.rule_description: Before populating account and customer fields on the update screen, the system checks whether account data and/or customer data was successfully retrieved from the master files. Account fields are displayed only if account or customer data was found; customer fields are displayed only if customer data was found.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Data Found in Master?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is being prepared for display after a data fetch attempt
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates whether account data was found in the Account Master file and whether customer data was found in the Customer Master file
acceptance_criteria.Then: If account data OR customer data was found, all account-level fields (Active Status, Current Balance, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date, Group ID) are populated on the screen; if customer data was found, all customer-level fields (Customer ID, SSN, FICO Score, Date of Birth, Name, Address, Phone Numbers, Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator) are populated on the screen; if neither account nor customer data was found, all detail fields remain blank

rules.rule_name: Display Account Active Status from Original Fetched Data
rules.rule_description: When account or customer data has been successfully retrieved from the master files, the original account active status value is displayed on the account update screen without modification.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Display Account Active Status

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files during the fetch operation
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the account section of the update screen with original fetched values
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Active Status field on the screen is populated with the originally fetched account active status value (ACUP-OLD-ACTIVE-STATUS) exactly as stored

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Balance with Currency Formatting
rules.rule_description: The original current balance numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Current Balance with Commas and Decimals

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original current balance numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N) is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the current balance field for display on the account update screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current balance numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Current Balance field (ACURBALO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Credit Limit with Currency Formatting
rules.rule_description: The original credit limit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Credit Limit with Commas and Decimals

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original credit limit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CREDIT-LIMIT-N) is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the credit limit field for display on the account update screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The credit limit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Credit Limit field (ACRDLIMO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Cash Credit Limit with Currency Formatting
rules.rule_description: The original cash credit limit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Cash Credit Limit with Commas and Decimals

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original cash credit limit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N) is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the cash credit limit field for display on the account update screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cash credit limit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Cash Credit Limit field (ACSHLIMO) on the screen

rules.rule_name: Format and Display Current Cycle Credit with Currency Formatting
rules.rule_description: The original current cycle credit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Current Cycle Credit with Commas and Decimals

acceptance_criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original current cycle credit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N) is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the current cycle credit field for display on the account update screen
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current cycle credit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Current Cycle Credit field (ACRCYCRO) on the screen

key_functionalities.title: Display Updated Values with Validation Results
key_functionalities.mermaid_diagram:
flowchart TD
    START([Display Updated Values with Validation Results])
    ACSTSTATUS[Display Account Active Status\nShow user-entered status value as-is]
    CREDITLIMIT{Credit Limit\nValidation Passed?}
    CREDITLIMIT_OK[Format Credit Limit\nDisplay with commas and decimals\ne.g. 10,000.00]
    CREDITLIMIT_ERR[Display Raw Credit Limit Input\nShow exactly what user typed]
    CASHCREDIT{Cash Credit Limit\nValidation Passed?}
    CASHCREDIT_OK[Format Cash Credit Limit\nDisplay with commas and decimals]
    CASHCREDIT_ERR[Display Raw Cash Credit Limit Input\nShow exactly what user typed]
    CURRBAL{Current Balance\nValidation Passed?}
    CURRBAL_OK[Format Current Balance\nDisplay with commas and decimals]
    CURRBAL_ERR[Display Raw Current Balance Input\nShow exactly what user typed]
    CYCLECREDIT{Current Cycle Credit\nValidation Passed?}
    CYCLECREDIT_OK[Format Current Cycle Credit\nDisplay with commas and decimals]
    CYCLECREDIT_ERR[Display Raw Current Cycle Credit Input\nShow exactly what user typed]
    CYCLEDEBIT{Current Cycle Debit\nValidation Passed?}
    CYCLEDEBIT_OK[Format Current Cycle Debit\nDisplay with commas and decimals]
    CYCLEDEBIT_ERR[Display Raw Current Cycle Debit Input\nShow exactly what user typed]
    DATES[Display Account Dates as Entered\nShow Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date\nyear, month, day parts as user entered]
    GROUPID[Display Group ID\nShow user-entered group ID as-is]
    CUSTID[Display Customer ID\nShow customer ID as-is]
    SSNPARTS[Display SSN Parts as Entered\nShow all three SSN segments\nexactly as user entered]
    FICO[Display FICO Score\nShow user-entered FICO score as-is]
    DOB[Display Date of Birth Parts as Entered\nShow year, month, day\nexactly as user entered]
    NAMES[Display Customer Name Fields\nShow first name, middle name,\nlast name as user entered]
    ADDRESS[Display Address Fields\nShow address line 1, address line 2,\ncity, state, zip code as user entered]
    COUNTRY[Display Country Code\nShow user-entered country code as-is]
    PHONES[Display Phone Number Parts as Entered\nShow area code, prefix, line number\nfor both phone numbers as user entered]
    GOVTID[Display Government Issued ID\nShow user-entered government ID as-is]
    EFT[Display EFT Account ID\nShow user-entered EFT account ID as-is]
    PRIHOLDER[Display Primary Card Holder Indicator\nShow user-entered Y or N indicator as-is]
    END([Screen Populated with Updated Values\nValid fields shown formatted,\nInvalid fields shown as raw input])

    START --> ACSTSTATUS
    ACSTSTATUS --> CREDITLIMIT
    CREDITLIMIT -->|Valid| CREDITLIMIT_OK
    CREDITLIMIT -->|Invalid| CREDITLIMIT_ERR
    CREDITLIMIT_OK --> CASHCREDIT
    CREDITLIMIT_ERR --> CASHCREDIT
    CASHCREDIT -->|Valid| CASHCREDIT_OK
    CASHCREDIT -->|Invalid| CASHCREDIT_ERR
    CASHCREDIT_OK --> CURRBAL
    CASHCREDIT_ERR --> CURRBAL
    CURRBAL -->|Valid| CURRBAL_OK
    CURRBAL -->|Invalid| CURRBAL_ERR
    CURRBAL_OK --> CYCLECREDIT
    CURRBAL_ERR --> CYCLECREDIT
    CYCLECREDIT -->|Valid| CYCLECREDIT_OK
    CYCLECREDIT -->|Invalid| CYCLECREDIT_ERR
    CYCLECREDIT_OK --> CYCLEDEBIT
    CYCLECREDIT_ERR --> CYCLEDEBIT
    CYCLEDEBIT -->|Valid| CYCLEDEBIT_OK
    CYCLEDEBIT -->|Invalid| CYCLEDEBIT_ERR
    CYCLEDEBIT_OK --> DATES
    CYCLEDEBIT_ERR --> DATES
    DATES --> GROUPID
    GROUPID --> CUSTID
    CUSTID --> SSNPARTS
    SSNPARTS --> FICO
    FICO --> DOB
    DOB --> NAMES
    NAMES --> ADDRESS
    ADDRESS --> COUNTRY
    COUNTRY --> PHONES
    PHONES --> GOVTID
    GOVTID --> EFT
    EFT --> PRIHOLDER
    PRIHOLDER --> END

rules.rule_name: Display Search Prompt on Fresh Program Entry
rules.rule_description: When the user enters the Account Update screen for the first time in a session, the informational message area should guide the user to enter an account number to begin the search process.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fresh Program Entry or No Account Fetched Yet

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Fresh Entry' (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is TRUE), indicating the user has just arrived at this screen for the first time in the current session
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys' (PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to enter an account number to search

rules.rule_name: Display Search Prompt When Account Details Have Not Been Fetched
rules.rule_description: When the Account Update screen is displayed but no account data has been retrieved yet (e.g., user has not yet searched for an account), the informational message area should prompt the user to enter an account number.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Fresh Program Entry or No Account Fetched Yet

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Details Not Fetched' (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is TRUE), meaning no account record has been retrieved from the system yet
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys' (PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to enter an account number to search

rules.rule_name: Display Change Prompt When Account Details Are Shown
rules.rule_description: When account and customer details have been successfully retrieved and are displayed on screen, the informational message area should guide the user to review and make changes to the account details.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account Details Are Displayed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Show Details' (ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS is TRUE), meaning account and customer data has been successfully fetched and is currently displayed on screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Changes' (PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to make changes to the displayed account details

rules.rule_name: Display Change Prompt When Submitted Changes Have Validation Errors
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes but one or more fields failed validation, the informational message area should prompt the user to correct the errors and resubmit, while the error message area shows the specific validation error.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Changes Were Made but Have Validation Errors

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Not OK' (ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK is TRUE), meaning the user submitted changes but at least one field failed business validation rules
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Changes' (PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to correct the validation errors and resubmit; the specific validation error detail is separately placed in the screen error area (ERRMSGO)

rules.rule_name: Display Confirmation Prompt When All Changes Are Validated
rules.rule_description: When the user has submitted changes that have all passed validation, the informational message area should prompt the user to press PF05 to confirm and permanently save the changes to the account and customer records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: All Changes Validated Successfully - Awaiting Confirmation

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED is TRUE), meaning all submitted field changes have passed all business validation rules but the user has not yet pressed PF05 to confirm
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Confirmation' (PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message instructing the user to press PF05 to confirm and save the validated changes

rules.rule_name: Display Success Confirmation When Account Update Is Completed
rules.rule_description: When the user has confirmed changes via PF05 and both the account and customer records have been successfully updated in the system, the informational message area should confirm to the user that the update was completed successfully.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Changes Were Confirmed and Saved Successfully

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Okayed and Done' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE is TRUE), meaning the user pressed PF05 to confirm, and both the Account Master record and the Customer Master record were successfully updated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Confirm Update Success' (CONFIRM-UPDATE-SUCCESS = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message confirming that the account update was completed successfully

rules.rule_name: Display Failure Message When Account or Customer Record Cannot Be Locked for Update
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms changes via PF05 but the system is unable to obtain an exclusive lock on the Account or Customer record (e.g., another user is currently updating the same record), the informational message area should inform the user that the update could not be completed due to a record lock issue.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Could Not Be Locked for Update

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Okayed - Lock Error' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR is TRUE), meaning the user pressed PF05 to confirm but the system failed to lock either the Account Master record or the Customer Master record for exclusive update
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Inform Failure' (INFORM-FAILURE = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message informing the user that the update failed because the record could not be locked for update

rules.rule_name: Display Failure Message When Record Was Locked But Update Write Failed
rules.rule_description: When the user confirms changes via PF05, the records are successfully locked, but the actual write operation to update the Account or Customer record fails, the informational message area should inform the user that the update could not be completed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Record Was Locked But Update Write Failed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Okayed But Failed' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED is TRUE), meaning the user pressed PF05 to confirm, the Account and Customer records were successfully locked, but the rewrite operation to one or both records failed (and any partial updates were rolled back)
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Inform Failure' (INFORM-FAILURE = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message informing the user that the update could not be completed

rules.rule_name: Display Default Search Prompt When No Specific Info Message State Is Detected
rules.rule_description: As a safety fallback, when the screen state does not match any of the known informational message states, the system defaults to displaying the account search prompt to ensure the user always receives actionable guidance.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No Specific Info Message State Detected

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state flag WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is TRUE, meaning none of the specific screen states (fresh entry, details not fetched, show details, changes not ok, changes ok not confirmed, changes done, lock error, update failed) have been set
acceptance_criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys' (PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS = TRUE) as the default fallback, which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to enter an account number to search

rules.rule_name: Place Resolved Informational Message into Screen Info Display Area
rules.rule_description: After the appropriate informational message type has been determined based on the current screen state, the resolved informational message text must be placed into the screen's designated informational message display field so it is visible to the user.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place Informational Message on Screen Info Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The informational message type has been determined (one of: Prompt for Search Keys, Prompt for Changes, Prompt for Confirmation, Confirm Update Success, or Inform Failure) AND the corresponding message text is held in the working storage field WS-INFO-MSG
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the screen content for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The content of WS-INFO-MSG is moved to the screen output field INFOMSGO in the screen map CACTUPAO, making the informational guidance message visible to the user in the designated info message area of the Account Update screen

rules.rule_name: Place Error or Return Message into Screen Error Display Area
rules.rule_description: In addition to the informational guidance message, any error or return message generated during input processing or validation must be placed into the screen's designated error message display field so the user can see the specific issue that needs to be addressed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Place Error or Return Message on Screen Error Area

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen content is being finalized for display AND a return or error message may have been generated during input validation or processing (held in working storage field WS-RETURN-MSG); note that only the first error encountered is captured in WS-RETURN-MSG due to the first-error-only policy
acceptance_criteria.When: The system finalizes the screen content for display, immediately after placing the informational message
acceptance_criteria.Then: The content of WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to the screen output field ERRMSGO in the screen map CACTUPAO, making the specific error or return message visible to the user in the designated error message area of the Account Update screen; if no error occurred, this field will be blank or contain the last return message

rules.rule_name: Default Protection of All Screen Fields
rules.rule_description: Before applying any state-specific rules, every field on the Account Update screen is set to read-only (protected) by default. This includes Account ID, Account Status, all balance and credit limit fields, all date fields, all customer detail fields (name, address, phone numbers, SSN, FICO Score, EFT Account ID, Government Issued ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator), and the informational message area.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Protect ALL Screen Fields
Set every field on screen to read-only
by default including:

Credit Limits, Dates, Customer Details,
Name, Address, Phone Numbers,
SSN, FICO Score, EFT, Info Message

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display in any processing state
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field protection setup process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen fields are set to read-only (protected) by default, including: Account ID, Account Active Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date (Year/Month/Day), Expiry Date (Year/Month/Day), Reissue Date (Year/Month/Day), Group ID, Customer ID, SSN Parts 1/2/3, FICO Credit Score, Date of Birth (Year/Month/Day), First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, Zip Code, Country Code, Phone Number 1 (Area/Prefix/Line), Phone Number 2 (Area/Prefix/Line), Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and the Informational Message area

rules.rule_name: Search Mode - Only Account ID Field is Editable
rules.rule_description: When the screen is in search mode (account details have not yet been fetched), all fields remain protected except the Account ID field, which is made editable so the user can enter an account number to search.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Search Mode Only
Keep all fields protected
except Account ID field
User can only enter an account number to search

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the current state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no account data has been loaded)

acceptance_criteria.Then: All fields remain read-only (protected) as set by default, AND only the Account ID field is made editable so the user can enter an account number to initiate a search; all other fields including account details, customer details, dates, balances, and the informational message area remain protected

rules.rule_name: Edit Mode - Selectively Unprotect Fields When Account Details Are Displayed or Validation Errors Exist
rules.rule_description: When the screen is in edit mode — either because account details have been successfully fetched and are being displayed, or because the user submitted changes that failed validation — selected account and customer fields are made editable while certain fields remain protected.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the current state is either 'Show Details' (account data fetched and displayed) OR 'Changes Not OK' (user submitted changes that failed validation)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field protection rules are applied based on the current processing state
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system invokes the selective field unprotection process to make account and customer detail fields editable while keeping specific fields (Customer ID, Country Code, Informational Message area) protected

rules.rule_name: Confirmation and Completed State - All Fields Remain Fully Protected
rules.rule_description: When the screen is in confirmation mode (changes have been validated and are awaiting user confirmation via PF5) or in completed state (update has been successfully saved), all fields remain fully protected and no editing is permitted.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Confirmation or
Completed State

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the current state is either 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (awaiting PF5 confirmation) OR 'Changes Okayed and Done' (update successfully completed)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field protection rules are applied based on the current processing state
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen fields remain read-only (protected) as set by the default protection step; no fields are made editable; the user cannot modify any data at this stage

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field When Details Not Yet Fetched
rules.rule_description: When the screen is in its initial state with no account details fetched, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID field to guide the user to enter an account number to search.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Position Cursor on Account ID Field
User needs to enter account number

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is displayed and the current state is 'Account Details Not Yet Fetched' (no account has been looked up yet)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account ID field so the user can enter an account number to search

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account Status Field When Account or Customer Data Found or No Changes Detected
rules.rule_description: When account or customer data has been successfully retrieved and displayed, or when the user submits the form with no changes detected, the cursor is positioned on the Account Status field as the first editable field for the user to begin making changes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account or Customer Data Found / No Changes?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is displayed and either account data or customer data has been found and loaded, OR no changes have been detected between the original and submitted values
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Status field (the first editable detail field) to prompt the user to begin editing

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field When Account Number Has an Error
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number field contains an invalid or missing value, the cursor is positioned on the Account ID field so the user can correct the account number entry.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account Number
Field Has Error?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is in a validation error state or changes are in progress
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number field has been flagged as invalid (either blank/not supplied or containing a non-numeric, zero, or non-11-digit value)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account ID field so the user can correct the account number

rules.rule_name: Position Cursor on Account Status Field When Account Status Has an Error

acceptance_criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Status field so the user can correct the account status value

rules.rule_name: Initialize All Screen Fields to Default Color
rules.rule_description: Before applying any error highlighting, all screen fields are reset to their default (non-error) color state so that only fields with current errors are highlighted in red.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set All Fields to Default Color
All screen fields start with
no error highlighting

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is about to be displayed to the user
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen color attribute setup process begins
acceptance_criteria.Then: All screen fields (Account Number, Account Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date Year/Month/Day, Expiry Date Year/Month/Day, Reissue Date Year/Month/Day, Group ID, Customer Number, SSN Parts 1/2/3, FICO Score, Date of Birth Year/Month/Day, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State, Zip, Country, Phone 1 Area/Prefix/Line, Phone 2 Area/Prefix/Line, Government ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and Info Message) are set to their default protected display attribute with no error color highlighting

rules.rule_name: Restrict Field Availability in Account Search Mode
rules.rule_description: When the screen is in search mode (no account details have been fetched yet), only the Account Number field is made available for user entry. All other fields remain protected and require no color change processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Only Account Number Field
Available for Entry
No color changes needed for other fields

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is in search mode, meaning no account details have been fetched yet (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen field protection and color attributes are being set up
acceptance_criteria.Then: Only the Account Number field (ACCTSIDA) is set to an unprotected/enterable state (DFHBMFSE); all other account and customer detail fields remain protected and no further color attribute changes are applied to detail fields

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Invalid
rules.rule_description: When the Account Number field fails validation (either blank or contains an invalid value), it is highlighted in red to alert the user. If the field was left blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed to indicate a required field was not supplied.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Account Number
Field in Error?
Highlight Account Number Field RED
Mark with asterisk if blank

acceptance_criteria.Given: The account update screen is being prepared for display and the program has re-entered (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is true)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account Number field has a validation error — either it was left blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true) or it contains an invalid value (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account Number field (ACCTSIDC) is highlighted in RED (DFHRED); additionally, if the field was blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true), an asterisk '*' is placed in the Account Number output field (ACCTSIDO) to indicate the field must be supplied

rules.rule_name: Stop Further Field Color Processing When Account Number Is in Error or Screen Is in Search Mode
rules.rule_description: When the screen is in search mode (no account fetched), or when the Account Number field itself is in error, no further field-level color highlighting is needed for account or customer detail fields, and the color setup process exits early.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
No Further Field
Color Changes Needed
Exit color setup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The screen color attribute setup is in progress
acceptance_criteria.When: The screen is in search mode (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is true), OR the Account Number field has a blank error (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true), OR the Account Number field has an invalid value error (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: No further color attribute changes are applied to any account or customer detail fields, and the color setup process exits immediately (GO TO 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS-EXIT)

rules.rule_name: Highlight Account Status Field in Red When Invalid

rules.rule_name: Identify Account Update Screen Layout for Display
rules.rule_description: Before transmitting any content to the user's terminal, the system must identify and register the correct Account Update screen layout (map and mapset) that will be used to render all account and customer data fields.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Set Screen Map Reference
Identify the Account Update
screen layout to be displayed

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has completed all screen content preparation including field values, informational messages, error highlights, and field protection attributes for the Account Update screen
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is ready to transmit the Account Update screen to the user's terminal
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the screen map reference to the Account Update screen map name (LIT-THISMAP) and the corresponding mapset name (LIT-THISMAPSET), storing them as the next map and mapset to be displayed, so that the correct screen layout is used for rendering all account and customer data

rules.rule_name: Transmit Prepared Account Update Screen Content to Terminal
rules.rule_description: The fully prepared Account Update screen — containing all account details, customer information, field values, error messages, guidance messages, and field attributes — must be transmitted to the user's terminal as a single atomic operation.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Transmit Screen to Terminal
Send all prepared screen content
including account and customer data
to the user's terminal
