Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A confirmed account update has passed all validations and the account record has already been successfully saved, and the system has locked the customer record for update
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the customer update record to be written to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The customer update record must be populated with all of the following new values: Customer ID, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City (Address Line 3), State Code, Country Code, Zip Code; Phone Number 1 formatted as (AAA)PPP-LLLL using the three entered parts (area code, prefix, line number); Phone Number 2 formatted as (AAA)PPP-LLLL using the three entered parts; SSN, Government Issued ID, Date of Birth formatted as YYYY-MM-DD using the three entered parts (year, month, day); EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and FICO Credit Score

all_rules.Rule_Name: Build Customer Update Record with All New Values
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before saving to the Customer Master file, the system assembles the complete customer update record by populating all editable customer fields with the newly entered values, including formatted phone numbers and date of birth.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The customer update record has been fully assembled with all new values and the customer record is locked for update in the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to write (rewrite) the updated customer record to the Customer Master file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The customer record in the Customer Master file is updated with all new values for the customer; the system then evaluates whether the write operation completed successfully to determine the next course of action

all_rules.Rule_Name: Save Updated Customer Record to Customer Master File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system writes the fully assembled customer update record to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT) as the final step of the account update process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has attempted to write the updated customer record to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation to the Customer Master file completes successfully (normal response received)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The update status is set to 'Changes Okayed and Done' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE), indicating that both the account record and the customer record have been successfully saved; the screen will subsequently display a success confirmation message to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirm Successful Customer Record Save
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the customer record is saved successfully to the Customer Master file, the overall update is marked as complete and successful, indicating that both the account and customer records have been persisted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account record has already been successfully written to the Account Master file (ACCTDAT) as part of the current update transaction, and the system has attempted to write the updated customer record to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The write operation to the Customer Master file fails (a non-normal response is received)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system issues a transaction rollback (SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK) to undo the previously saved account record changes, ensuring that the Account Master file is restored to its state before the update began, thereby maintaining data consistency between the Account Master file and the Customer Master file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Roll Back Account Update When Customer Save Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the customer record cannot be saved to the Customer Master file after the account record has already been written, the system must roll back the account record update to ensure both files remain consistent with each other.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The write operation to the Customer Master file (CUSTDAT) has failed and the system has issued a rollback to undo the account record update
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The rollback of the account update completes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The update status is set to 'Locked But Update Failed' (LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED), indicating that the update process failed and neither the account record nor the customer record changes have been persisted; the screen will subsequently display a failure message to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark Update as Failed After Customer Save Failure and Rollback
all_rules.Rule_Description: After a customer record save failure and subsequent rollback of the account update, the overall update status is marked as failed so the user is informed that neither the account nor the customer changes were saved.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is about to be prepared for display to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen initialization begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All output fields on the Account Update screen (CACTUPAO) are cleared and reset to blank/empty values, ensuring no previously displayed data remains visible

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear Screen Output Fields Before Initialization
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating any screen fields, all output fields on the Account Update screen must be reset to blank/empty state to ensure no residual data from a previous display is shown to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system retrieves the current date and time
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current date and time are obtained from the system and stored in the working storage date/time data area (WS-CURDATE-DATA), making both date components (year, month, day) and time components (hours, minutes, seconds) available for formatting and display

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Current System Date and Time
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must obtain the current date and time from the operating environment to display accurate timestamp information in the screen header for the user's reference.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized and application title constants (CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02) are defined
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Screen titles are set during initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first application title line (CCDA-TITLE01) is placed in the first title field (TITLE01O) of the screen, and the second application title line (CCDA-TITLE02) is placed in the second title field (TITLE02O) of the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Application Title Lines in Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account Update screen header must display the standard application title lines as defined by the application's title constants, providing consistent branding and screen identification across the application.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized and the current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) is defined
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction ID is set in the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current transaction identifier (LIT-THISTRANID) is displayed in the transaction name field (TRNNAMEO) of the Account Update screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Transaction Identifier in Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the transaction ID of the currently executing transaction, allowing users and support staff to identify which transaction is active on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being initialized and the current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is defined
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program name is set in the screen header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current program name (LIT-THISPGM) is displayed in the program name field (PGMNAMEO) of the Account Update screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Current Program Name in Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The screen header must display the name of the currently executing program, enabling users and support staff to identify which program is generating the displayed screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system date has been retrieved and stored in WS-CURDATE-DATA, containing separate year, month, and day components
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current date is formatted for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The month component (WS-CURDATE-MONTH) is extracted into the MM position (WS-CURDATE-MM), the day component (WS-CURDATE-DAY) is extracted into the DD position (WS-CURDATE-DD), and only the last 2 digits of the year (positions 3 and 4 of WS-CURDATE-YEAR) are extracted into the YY position (WS-CURDATE-YY), resulting in a date formatted as MM/DD/YY in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Date as MM/DD/YY for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current system date must be formatted into the MM/DD/YY display format by extracting the individual month, day, and 2-digit year components from the system date, so it can be presented in a user-friendly format on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current date has been formatted into MM/DD/YY format and stored in WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The formatted date is placed on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted date (WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY) is moved to the current date output field (CURDATEO) on the Account Update screen (CACTUPAO), making it visible to the user in the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Date in Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted current date in MM/DD/YY format must be placed into the designated date display field on the Account Update screen header so users can see the current date while working with the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current system time has been retrieved as part of WS-CURDATE-DATA, containing separate hours, minutes, and seconds components
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The current time is formatted for screen display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The hours component (WS-CURTIME-HOURS) is extracted into the HH position (WS-CURTIME-HH), the minutes component (WS-CURTIME-MINUTE) is extracted into the MM position (WS-CURTIME-MM), and the seconds component (WS-CURTIME-SECOND) is extracted into the SS position (WS-CURTIME-SS), resulting in a time formatted as HH:MM:SS in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Current Time as HH:MM:SS for Screen Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: The current system time must be formatted into the HH:MM:SS display format by extracting the individual hours, minutes, and seconds components from the system time, so it can be presented in a user-friendly format on the screen header.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The current time has been formatted into HH:MM:SS format and stored in WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The formatted time is placed on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The formatted time (WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS) is moved to the current time output field (CURTIMEO) on the Account Update screen (CACTUPAO), making it visible to the user in the screen header

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Time in Screen Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted current time in HH:MM:SS format must be placed into the designated time display field on the Account Update screen header so users can see the current time while working with the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program is in a fresh entry state (first-time entry into the program, indicated by the program-enter flag being set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether to populate screen data fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system skips all data field population routines entirely, leaving all account, customer, date, address, and contact fields empty on the screen, and proceeds directly to sending the blank screen to the user

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Data Field Population on Fresh Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a user accesses the Account Update screen for the very first time in a session (fresh entry), the system bypasses all data field population logic and leaves the screen fields empty, ready for the user to enter a search account number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for a returning user (not a fresh program entry) AND the Account ID field on screen is populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system routes display as follows: (1) If the screen state is 'Details Not Fetched' OR the Account ID value is zero, display the initial empty screen (blank all data fields); (2) If the screen state is 'Show Details', display the original values fetched from the account and customer master files; (3) If the screen state is 'Changes Made' (changes in progress), display the user-entered updated values; (4) For any other state, display the original fetched values as a default

all_rules.Rule_Name: Route Screen Display Based on Current Account Search State
all_rules.Rule_Description: For a returning user (not a fresh entry), the system evaluates the current screen state to determine which set of data values to display — blank initial values, original fetched values, or user-entered updated values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for a returning user AND the current screen state is either 'Account Details Not Yet Fetched' OR the Account ID currently held is zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system determines which display routine to invoke
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the initial empty screen display routine (3201-SHOW-INITIAL-VALUES), which clears all account, customer, date, address, and contact data fields on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Trigger Initial Empty Screen When No Account Has Been Searched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a returning user has not yet performed an account search (details not fetched state) or the Account ID is zero, the system triggers the initial empty screen display, clearing all data fields to present a clean search interface.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following account fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Account Active Status, Credit Limit, Current Balance, Cash Credit Limit, Current Cycle Credit amount, and Current Cycle Debit amount

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Account Financial Fields on Initial Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all account financial and status fields are cleared to blank so the user sees an empty form ready for a new account search.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following date fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Open Date Year, Open Date Month, Open Date Day, Expiry Date Year, Expiry Date Month, Expiry Date Day, Reissue Date Year, Reissue Date Month, and Reissue Date Day

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Date Fields on Initial Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all date-related fields for account open date, expiry date, and reissue date are cleared to blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following customer identity fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Customer ID, SSN Part 1 (first 3 digits), SSN Part 2 (4th and 5th digits), SSN Part 3 (last 4 digits), FICO Credit Score, Date of Birth Year, Date of Birth Month, and Date of Birth Day

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Customer Identity Fields on Initial Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer identity fields including Customer ID, Social Security Number parts, FICO credit score, and date of birth are cleared to blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following customer name fields are cleared to blank on the screen: First Name, Middle Name, and Last Name

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Customer Name Fields on Initial Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer name fields are cleared to blank so no previously viewed customer name data is visible.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following address and grouping fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, Zip Code, Country Code, and Account Group ID

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Address and Group Fields on Initial Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer address fields and the account group identifier are cleared to blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has determined that the initial empty screen must be displayed (no account searched yet or Account ID is zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the initial values display routine
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following contact and identification fields are cleared to blank on the screen: Phone Number 1 Area Code, Phone Number 1 Prefix, Phone Number 1 Line Number, Phone Number 2 Area Code, Phone Number 2 Prefix, Phone Number 2 Line Number, Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, and Primary Card Holder Indicator

all_rules.Rule_Name: Clear All Contact and Identification Fields on Initial Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying the initial empty screen, all customer contact fields including both phone numbers (each split into area code, prefix, and line number), government-issued ID, EFT account ID, and primary card holder indicator are cleared to blank.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The initial empty screen display routine has cleared all data fields AND the current screen state is 'Account Details Not Yet Fetched'
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets screen field protection attributes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen fields (Account Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Cycle Credit, Cycle Debit, all date fields, all customer fields, all name fields, all address fields, all contact fields, Government ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and the information message area) are set to protected/read-only; AND the Account ID field alone is set to unprotected/editable so the user can enter an account number to search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Protect All Fields and Activate Only Account ID for Input on Empty Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all data fields are cleared for the initial empty screen, the system sets all screen fields to protected (read-only) and then specifically makes only the Account ID field editable, so the user can only enter an account number to initiate a search.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen is being prepared for display after a data fetch attempt
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates whether account data was found in the Account Master file and whether customer data was found in the Customer Master file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If account data OR customer data was found, all account-level fields (Active Status, Current Balance, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date, Group ID) are populated on the screen; if customer data was found, all customer-level fields (Customer ID, SSN, FICO Score, Date of Birth, Name, Address, Phone Numbers, Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator) are populated on the screen; if neither account nor customer data was found, all detail fields remain blank

all_rules.Rule_Name: Determine Eligibility to Display Account and Customer Data on Screen
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating account and customer fields on the update screen, the system checks whether account data and/or customer data was successfully retrieved from the master files. Account fields are displayed only if account or customer data was found; customer fields are displayed only if customer data was found.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files during the fetch operation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the account section of the update screen with original fetched values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Active Status field on the screen is populated with the originally fetched account active status value (ACUP-OLD-ACTIVE-STATUS) exactly as stored

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Active Status from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account or customer data has been successfully retrieved from the master files, the original account active status value is displayed on the account update screen without modification.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original current balance numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CURR-BAL-N) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the current balance field for display on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current balance numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Current Balance field (ACURBALO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Current Balance with Currency Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original current balance numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original credit limit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CREDIT-LIMIT-N) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the credit limit field for display on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The credit limit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Credit Limit field (ACRDLIMO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Credit Limit with Currency Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original credit limit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original cash credit limit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the cash credit limit field for display on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cash credit limit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Cash Credit Limit field (ACSHLIMO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Cash Credit Limit with Currency Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original cash credit limit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original current cycle credit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the current cycle credit field for display on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current cycle credit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Current Cycle Credit field (ACRCYCRO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Current Cycle Credit with Currency Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original current cycle credit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original current cycle debit numeric value (ACUP-OLD-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares the current cycle debit field for display on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current cycle debit numeric value is passed through the currency formatting template (WS-EDIT-CURRENCY-9-2-F) which applies comma separators and two decimal places, and the formatted result is displayed in the Current Cycle Debit field (ACRCYDBO) on the screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Display Current Cycle Debit with Currency Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original current cycle debit numeric value retrieved from the Account Master is formatted with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original account date components are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the date fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Open Date is displayed as three separate fields: Open Year (ACUP-OLD-OPEN-YEAR to OPNYEARO), Open Month (ACUP-OLD-OPEN-MON to OPNMONO), Open Day (ACUP-OLD-OPEN-DAY to OPNDAYO); the Expiry Date is displayed as three separate fields: Expiry Year (ACUP-OLD-EXP-YEAR to EXPYEARO), Expiry Month (ACUP-OLD-EXP-MON to EXPMONO), Expiry Day (ACUP-OLD-EXP-DAY to EXPDAYO); the Reissue Date is displayed as three separate fields: Reissue Year (ACUP-OLD-REISSUE-YEAR to RISYEARO), Reissue Month (ACUP-OLD-REISSUE-MON to RISMONO), Reissue Day (ACUP-OLD-REISSUE-DAY to RISDAYO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Open Date, Expiry Date, and Reissue Date as Separate Year, Month, Day Components
all_rules.Rule_Description: The three account dates (Open Date, Expiry Date, Reissue Date) are each displayed as three separate fields — Year, Month, and Day — on the account update screen using the originally fetched values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Account data or customer data was found in the master files and the original group ID (ACUP-OLD-GROUP-ID) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the account section of the update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Group ID field (AADDGRPO) on the screen is populated with the originally fetched group ID value exactly as stored

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Group ID from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original account group ID value retrieved from the Account Master is displayed on the account update screen without modification.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file during the fetch operation
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the customer section of the update screen with original fetched values
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Customer ID field (ACSTNUMO) on the screen is populated with the originally fetched customer ID value (ACUP-OLD-CUST-ID-X)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer ID from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: When customer data has been successfully retrieved from the Customer Master file, the original customer ID is displayed on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original SSN (ACUP-OLD-CUST-SSN-X) is available as a single concatenated value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the SSN fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first SSN field (ACTSSN1O) is populated with characters 1 through 3 of the stored SSN; the second SSN field (ACTSSN2O) is populated with characters 4 through 5 of the stored SSN; the third SSN field (ACTSSN3O) is populated with characters 6 through 9 of the stored SSN

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Social Security Number Split into Three Separate Parts
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer's Social Security Number stored as a single value is split into three separate display fields: the first 3 digits, the middle 2 digits (positions 4-5), and the last 4 digits (positions 6-9), matching the standard SSN format (XXX-XX-XXXX).

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original FICO credit score (ACUP-OLD-CUST-FICO-SCORE-X) is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the customer section of the update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The FICO Credit Score field (ACSTFCOO) on the screen is populated with the originally fetched FICO score value exactly as stored

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer FICO Credit Score from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The original FICO credit score value retrieved from the Customer Master is displayed on the account update screen without modification.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original date of birth components (ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-YEAR, ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-MON, ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-DAY) are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the date of birth fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Date of Birth Year field (DOBYEARO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-YEAR; the Date of Birth Month field (DOBMONO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-MON; the Date of Birth Day field (DOBDAYO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-DOB-DAY

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer Date of Birth as Separate Year, Month, Day Components
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer's date of birth is displayed as three separate fields — Year, Month, and Day — on the account update screen using the originally fetched values.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original name components (ACUP-OLD-CUST-FIRST-NAME, ACUP-OLD-CUST-MIDDLE-NAME, ACUP-OLD-CUST-LAST-NAME) are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the customer name fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The First Name field (ACSFNAMO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-FIRST-NAME; the Middle Name field (ACSMNAMO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-MIDDLE-NAME; the Last Name field (ACSLNAMO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-LAST-NAME

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer Full Name (First, Middle, Last) from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer's full name — comprising first name, middle name, and last name — as originally retrieved from the Customer Master is displayed in three separate fields on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original address components are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the customer address fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Address Line 1 field (ACSADL1O) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-LINE-1; Address Line 2 field (ACSADL2O) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-LINE-2; City field (ACSCITYO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-LINE-3; State field (ACSSTTEO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD; Zip Code field (ACSZIPCO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-ZIP; Country field (ACSCTRYO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-ADDR-COUNTRY-CD

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer Address Components from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer's full address — comprising address line 1, address line 2, city (stored as address line 3), state code, zip code, and country code — as originally retrieved from the Customer Master is displayed in separate fields on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original phone numbers (ACUP-OLD-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1 and ACUP-OLD-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2) are stored in the format (AAA)PPP-LLLL
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the phone number fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For Phone Number 1: the Area Code field (ACSPH1AO) is populated with characters at positions 2 through 4 (3 characters) of ACUP-OLD-CUST-PHONE-NUM-1; the Prefix field (ACSPH1BO) is populated with characters at positions 6 through 8 (3 characters); the Line Number field (ACSPH1CO) is populated with characters at positions 10 through 13 (4 characters); For Phone Number 2: the Area Code field (ACSPH2AO) is populated with characters at positions 2 through 4 (3 characters) of ACUP-OLD-CUST-PHONE-NUM-2; the Prefix field (ACSPH2BO) is populated with characters at positions 6 through 8 (3 characters); the Line Number field (ACSPH2CO) is populated with characters at positions 10 through 13 (4 characters)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Phone Numbers by Extracting Area Code, Prefix, and Line Number from Stored Formatted String
all_rules.Rule_Description: Phone numbers are stored in the Customer Master in a formatted string pattern (AAA)PPP-LLLL. When displaying on screen, the area code, prefix, and line number are extracted from specific character positions of the stored string and placed into three separate display fields for each phone number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Customer data was found in the Customer Master file and the original values for government issued ID (ACUP-OLD-CUST-GOVT-ISSUED-ID), EFT account ID (ACUP-OLD-CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID), and primary card holder indicator (ACUP-OLD-CUST-PRI-HOLDER-IND) are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the remaining customer detail fields on the account update screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Government Issued ID field (ACSGOVTO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-GOVT-ISSUED-ID; the EFT Account ID field (ACSEFTCO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID; the Primary Card Holder Indicator field (ACSPFLGO) is populated with ACUP-OLD-CUST-PRI-HOLDER-IND

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, and Primary Card Holder Indicator from Original Fetched Data
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer's government issued ID, EFT account ID, and primary card holder indicator as originally retrieved from the Customer Master are displayed in their respective fields on the account update screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen has been populated with the original fetched account and customer data and the program state is set to Show Details (ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system sets the informational guidance message for the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The screen state flag is set to PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES and the non-key flags (WS-NON-KEY-FLAGS) are cleared to LOW-VALUES, causing the informational message area to display a prompt instructing the user to make changes to the displayed data

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Screen Guidance Message to Prompt User to Make Changes After Data Display
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the original account and customer data has been displayed on the screen, the informational message area is set to prompt the user to review the data and make any desired changes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the screen is in the 'Display Updated Values' state
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Account Active Status field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Active Status field displays the exact value entered by the user (e.g., 'Y' or 'N') without any reformatting or transformation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Active Status As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: When displaying updated values after user edits, the Account Active Status field is always shown exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Credit Limit field has passed validation (FLG-CRED-LIMIT-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Credit Limit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Limit is converted to a numeric value and displayed in formatted currency style with commas and two decimal places (e.g., 10,000.00)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Credit Limit When Validation Passes
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Credit Limit value entered by the user passes validation, it is formatted as a currency value with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Credit Limit field has failed validation (FLG-CRED-LIMIT-ISVALID is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Credit Limit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Credit Limit field displays the raw alphanumeric text exactly as the user originally typed it, without any numeric formatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Raw Credit Limit Input When Validation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Credit Limit value entered by the user fails validation, the raw unformatted input is displayed on the screen exactly as the user typed it, allowing the user to see and correct their entry.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Cash Credit Limit field has passed validation (FLG-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Cash Credit Limit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cash Credit Limit is converted to a numeric value and displayed in formatted currency style with commas and two decimal places

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Cash Credit Limit When Validation Passes
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Cash Credit Limit value entered by the user passes validation, it is formatted as a currency value with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Cash Credit Limit field has failed validation (FLG-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-ISVALID is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Cash Credit Limit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cash Credit Limit field displays the raw alphanumeric text exactly as the user originally typed it, without any numeric formatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Raw Cash Credit Limit Input When Validation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Cash Credit Limit value entered by the user fails validation, the raw unformatted input is displayed on the screen exactly as the user typed it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Current Balance field has passed validation (FLG-CURR-BAL-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Current Balance field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Balance is converted to a numeric value and displayed in formatted currency style with commas and two decimal places

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Current Balance When Validation Passes
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Current Balance value entered by the user passes validation, it is formatted as a currency value with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Current Balance field has failed validation (FLG-CURR-BAL-ISVALID is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Current Balance field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Balance field displays the raw alphanumeric text exactly as the user originally typed it, without any numeric formatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Raw Current Balance Input When Validation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Current Balance value entered by the user fails validation, the raw unformatted input is displayed on the screen exactly as the user typed it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Current Cycle Credit field has passed validation (FLG-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Current Cycle Credit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Credit is converted to a numeric value and displayed in formatted currency style with commas and two decimal places

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Current Cycle Credit When Validation Passes
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Current Cycle Credit value entered by the user passes validation, it is formatted as a currency value with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Current Cycle Credit field has failed validation (FLG-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-ISVALID is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Current Cycle Credit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Credit field displays the raw alphanumeric text exactly as the user originally typed it, without any numeric formatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Raw Current Cycle Credit Input When Validation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Current Cycle Credit value entered by the user fails validation, the raw unformatted input is displayed on the screen exactly as the user typed it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Current Cycle Debit field has passed validation (FLG-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-ISVALID is set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Current Cycle Debit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Debit is converted to a numeric value and displayed in formatted currency style with commas and two decimal places

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Formatted Current Cycle Debit When Validation Passes
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Current Cycle Debit value entered by the user passes validation, it is formatted as a currency value with commas and two decimal places before being displayed on the screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes and the Current Cycle Debit field has failed validation (FLG-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-ISVALID is NOT set)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Current Cycle Debit field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Current Cycle Debit field displays the raw alphanumeric text exactly as the user originally typed it, without any numeric formatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Raw Current Cycle Debit Input When Validation Fails
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Current Cycle Debit value entered by the user fails validation, the raw unformatted input is displayed on the screen exactly as the user typed it.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing Open Date, Expiry Date, and Reissue Date values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the date fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Open Date Year, Open Date Month, Open Date Day, Expiry Date Year, Expiry Date Month, Expiry Date Day, Reissue Date Year, Reissue Date Month, and Reissue Date Day fields each display the exact value the user entered, regardless of whether date validation passed or failed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Account Date Fields As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The three account date fields — Open Date, Expiry Date, and Reissue Date — are each stored and displayed as three separate components (Year, Month, Day). All six date part fields are always displayed exactly as the user entered them, with no conditional formatting based on validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing a Group ID value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Group ID field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Group ID field displays the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Group ID As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account Group ID field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing a Customer ID value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Customer ID field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Customer ID field displays the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer ID As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Customer ID field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing SSN values across three fields (first 3 digits, 4th and 5th digits, last 4 digits)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the SSN fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: SSN Part 1 (first 3 digits), SSN Part 2 (4th and 5th digits), and SSN Part 3 (last 4 digits) each display the exact value the user entered, regardless of whether SSN validation passed or failed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display SSN Parts As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Social Security Number (SSN) is stored and displayed as three separate segments. All three SSN parts are always displayed exactly as the user entered them, with no conditional formatting based on validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing a FICO Score value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the FICO Score field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The FICO Score field displays the exact alphanumeric value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display FICO Score As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The FICO Credit Score field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing Date of Birth values across three fields (year, month, day)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Date of Birth fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Date of Birth Year, Date of Birth Month, and Date of Birth Day each display the exact value the user entered, regardless of whether date of birth validation passed or failed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Date of Birth Parts As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer Date of Birth is stored and displayed as three separate components (Year, Month, Day). All three date of birth parts are always displayed exactly as the user entered them, with no conditional formatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing customer name values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the customer name fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The First Name, Middle Name, and Last Name fields each display the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Customer Name Fields As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer name fields — First Name, Middle Name, and Last Name — are always displayed exactly as the user entered them, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing customer address values
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the address fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, and Zip Code fields each display the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Address Fields As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The customer address fields — Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City (Address Line 3), State Code, and Zip Code — are always displayed exactly as the user entered them, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing a Country Code value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Country Code field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Country Code field displays the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Country Code As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Country Code field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing phone number values across six fields (area code, prefix, and line number for Phone Number 1 and Phone Number 2)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the phone number fields on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Phone Number 1 Area Code, Phone Number 1 Prefix, Phone Number 1 Line Number, Phone Number 2 Area Code, Phone Number 2 Prefix, and Phone Number 2 Line Number each display the exact value the user entered, regardless of whether phone number validation passed or failed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Phone Number Parts As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: Both phone numbers are stored and displayed as three separate components each (Area Code, Prefix, Line Number). All six phone number parts across both phone numbers are always displayed exactly as the user entered them, with no conditional formatting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing a Government Issued ID value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Government Issued ID field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Government Issued ID field displays the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Government Issued ID As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Government Issued ID field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing an EFT Account ID value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the EFT Account ID field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The EFT Account ID field displays the exact value the user entered without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display EFT Account ID As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) Account ID field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it, without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The user has submitted account update changes containing a Primary Card Holder Indicator value
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Primary Card Holder Indicator field on the screen
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Primary Card Holder Indicator field displays the exact value the user entered (Y or N) without any reformatting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Primary Card Holder Indicator As Entered
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Primary Card Holder Indicator field is always displayed exactly as the user entered it (Y or N), without any formatting transformation, regardless of validation outcome.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Fresh Entry' (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER is TRUE), indicating the user has just arrived at this screen for the first time in the current session
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys' (PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to enter an account number to search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Search Prompt on Fresh Program Entry
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user enters the Account Update screen for the first time in a session, the informational message area should guide the user to enter an account number to begin the search process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Details Not Fetched' (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is TRUE), meaning no account record has been retrieved from the system yet
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys' (PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to enter an account number to search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Search Prompt When Account Details Have Not Been Fetched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Update screen is displayed but no account data has been retrieved yet (e.g., user has not yet searched for an account), the informational message area should prompt the user to enter an account number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Show Details' (ACUP-SHOW-DETAILS is TRUE), meaning account and customer data has been successfully fetched and is currently displayed on screen
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Changes' (PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to make changes to the displayed account details

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Change Prompt When Account Details Are Shown
all_rules.Rule_Description: When account and customer details have been successfully retrieved and are displayed on screen, the informational message area should guide the user to review and make changes to the account details.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Not OK' (ACUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK is TRUE), meaning the user submitted changes but at least one field failed business validation rules
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Changes' (PROMPT-FOR-CHANGES = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to correct the validation errors and resubmit; the specific validation error detail is separately placed in the screen error area (ERRMSGO)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Change Prompt When Submitted Changes Have Validation Errors
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes but one or more fields failed validation, the informational message area should prompt the user to correct the errors and resubmit, while the error message area shows the specific validation error.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED is TRUE), meaning all submitted field changes have passed all business validation rules but the user has not yet pressed PF05 to confirm
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Confirmation' (PROMPT-FOR-CONFIRMATION = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message instructing the user to press PF05 to confirm and save the validated changes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Confirmation Prompt When All Changes Are Validated
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has submitted changes that have all passed validation, the informational message area should prompt the user to press PF05 to confirm and permanently save the changes to the account and customer records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Okayed and Done' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE is TRUE), meaning the user pressed PF05 to confirm, and both the Account Master record and the Customer Master record were successfully updated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Confirm Update Success' (CONFIRM-UPDATE-SUCCESS = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message confirming that the account update was completed successfully

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Success Confirmation When Account Update Is Completed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user has confirmed changes via PF05 and both the account and customer records have been successfully updated in the system, the informational message area should confirm to the user that the update was completed successfully.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Okayed - Lock Error' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-LOCK-ERROR is TRUE), meaning the user pressed PF05 to confirm but the system failed to lock either the Account Master record or the Customer Master record for exclusive update
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Inform Failure' (INFORM-FAILURE = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message informing the user that the update failed because the record could not be locked for update

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Failure Message When Account or Customer Record Cannot Be Locked for Update
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms changes via PF05 but the system is unable to obtain an exclusive lock on the Account or Customer record (e.g., another user is currently updating the same record), the informational message area should inform the user that the update could not be completed due to a record lock issue.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state is 'Changes Okayed But Failed' (ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-BUT-FAILED is TRUE), meaning the user pressed PF05 to confirm, the Account and Customer records were successfully locked, but the rewrite operation to one or both records failed (and any partial updates were rolled back)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Inform Failure' (INFORM-FAILURE = TRUE), which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message informing the user that the update could not be completed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Failure Message When Record Was Locked But Update Write Failed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the user confirms changes via PF05, the records are successfully locked, but the actual write operation to update the Account or Customer record fails, the informational message area should inform the user that the update could not be completed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the program state flag WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE is TRUE, meaning none of the specific screen states (fresh entry, details not fetched, show details, changes not ok, changes ok not confirmed, changes done, lock error, update failed) have been set
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the current screen state to determine which informational message to display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The informational message type is set to 'Prompt for Search Keys' (PROMPT-FOR-SEARCH-KEYS = TRUE) as the default fallback, which causes the screen info area (INFOMSGO) to display a message prompting the user to enter an account number to search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Default Search Prompt When No Specific Info Message State Is Detected
all_rules.Rule_Description: As a safety fallback, when the screen state does not match any of the known informational message states, the system defaults to displaying the account search prompt to ensure the user always receives actionable guidance.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The informational message type has been determined (one of: Prompt for Search Keys, Prompt for Changes, Prompt for Confirmation, Confirm Update Success, or Inform Failure) AND the corresponding message text is held in the working storage field WS-INFO-MSG
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system finalizes the screen content for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The content of WS-INFO-MSG is moved to the screen output field INFOMSGO in the screen map CACTUPAO, making the informational guidance message visible to the user in the designated info message area of the Account Update screen

all_rules.Rule_Name: Place Resolved Informational Message into Screen Info Display Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the appropriate informational message type has been determined based on the current screen state, the resolved informational message text must be placed into the screen's designated informational message display field so it is visible to the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen content is being finalized for display AND a return or error message may have been generated during input validation or processing (held in working storage field WS-RETURN-MSG); note that only the first error encountered is captured in WS-RETURN-MSG due to the first-error-only policy
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system finalizes the screen content for display, immediately after placing the informational message
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The content of WS-RETURN-MSG is moved to the screen output field ERRMSGO in the screen map CACTUPAO, making the specific error or return message visible to the user in the designated error message area of the Account Update screen; if no error occurred, this field will be blank or contain the last return message

all_rules.Rule_Name: Place Error or Return Message into Screen Error Display Area
all_rules.Rule_Description: In addition to the informational guidance message, any error or return message generated during input processing or validation must be placed into the screen's designated error message display field so the user can see the specific issue that needs to be addressed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display in any processing state
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field protection setup process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen fields are set to read-only (protected) by default, including: Account ID, Account Active Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date (Year/Month/Day), Expiry Date (Year/Month/Day), Reissue Date (Year/Month/Day), Group ID, Customer ID, SSN Parts 1/2/3, FICO Credit Score, Date of Birth (Year/Month/Day), First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, Zip Code, Country Code, Phone Number 1 (Area/Prefix/Line), Phone Number 2 (Area/Prefix/Line), Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and the Informational Message area

all_rules.Rule_Name: Default Protection of All Screen Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before applying any state-specific rules, every field on the Account Update screen is set to read-only (protected) by default. This includes Account ID, Account Status, all balance and credit limit fields, all date fields, all customer detail fields (name, address, phone numbers, SSN, FICO Score, EFT Account ID, Government Issued ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator), and the informational message area.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the current state is 'Details Not Yet Fetched' (no account data has been loaded)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field protection rules are applied based on the current processing state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All fields remain read-only (protected) as set by default, AND only the Account ID field is made editable so the user can enter an account number to initiate a search; all other fields including account details, customer details, dates, balances, and the informational message area remain protected

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Mode - Only Account ID Field is Editable
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is in search mode (account details have not yet been fetched), all fields remain protected except the Account ID field, which is made editable so the user can enter an account number to search.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the current state is either 'Show Details' (account data fetched and displayed) OR 'Changes Not OK' (user submitted changes that failed validation)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field protection rules are applied based on the current processing state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system invokes the selective field unprotection process to make account and customer detail fields editable while keeping specific fields (Customer ID, Country Code, Informational Message area) protected

all_rules.Rule_Name: Edit Mode - Selectively Unprotect Fields When Account Details Are Displayed or Validation Errors Exist
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is in edit mode — either because account details have been successfully fetched and are being displayed, or because the user submitted changes that failed validation — selected account and customer fields are made editable while certain fields remain protected.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display AND the current state is either 'Changes OK - Not Confirmed' (awaiting PF5 confirmation) OR 'Changes Okayed and Done' (update successfully completed)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field protection rules are applied based on the current processing state
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen fields remain read-only (protected) as set by the default protection step; no fields are made editable; the user cannot modify any data at this stage

all_rules.Rule_Name: Confirmation and Completed State - All Fields Remain Fully Protected
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is in confirmation mode (changes have been validated and are awaiting user confirmation via PF5) or in completed state (update has been successfully saved), all fields remain fully protected and no editing is permitted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in edit mode (state is 'Show Details' or 'Changes Not OK') AND the selective field unprotection process has been invoked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Account field protection attributes are being set

all_rules.Rule_Name: Edit Mode - Unprotect Account Detail Fields for User Modification
all_rules.Rule_Description: In edit mode, the following account-level fields are made editable so the user can modify account details: Account Active Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date (Year, Month, Day), Expiry Date (Year, Month, Day), Reissue Date (Year, Month, Day), and Group ID.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in edit mode (state is 'Show Details' or 'Changes Not OK') AND the selective field unprotection process is setting field attributes
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Customer ID field protection attribute is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Customer ID field is explicitly set to protected (read-only) and remains non-editable regardless of the edit mode; the user can view the Customer ID but cannot change it

all_rules.Rule_Name: Edit Mode - Customer ID is Always Read-Only and Cannot Be Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: Even when the screen is in edit mode and most account and customer fields are editable, the Customer ID field is always kept protected (read-only). The Customer ID is a system-assigned link between the account and the customer and cannot be modified by the user.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in edit mode (state is 'Show Details' or 'Changes Not OK') AND the Customer ID field has been kept protected AND the selective field unprotection process continues
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Customer field protection attributes are being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The following customer fields are made editable (unprotected): SSN Part 1 (first 3 digits), SSN Part 2 (4th and 5th digits), SSN Part 3 (last 4 digits), FICO Credit Score, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, Zip Code, Phone Number 1 Area Code, Phone Number 1 Prefix, Phone Number 1 Line Number, Phone Number 2 Area Code, Phone Number 2 Prefix, Phone Number 2 Line Number, Government Issued ID, EFT Account ID, and Primary Card Holder Indicator

all_rules.Rule_Name: Edit Mode - Unprotect Customer Detail Fields for User Modification
all_rules.Rule_Description: In edit mode, the following customer-level fields are made editable so the user can modify customer details: SSN Parts 1, 2, and 3; FICO Credit Score; First Name, Middle Name, Last Name; Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State Code, Zip Code; Phone Number 1 (Area Code, Prefix, Line Number); Phone Number 2 (Area Code, Prefix, Line Number); Government Issued ID; EFT Account ID; and Primary Card Holder Indicator.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen is in edit mode (state is 'Show Details' or 'Changes Not OK') AND the selective field unprotection process is setting customer field attributes

all_rules.Rule_Name: Edit Mode - Country Code is Always Read-Only and Cannot Be Changed
all_rules.Rule_Description: Even when the screen is in edit mode and most customer fields are editable, the Country Code field is always kept protected (read-only). The Country Code is a display-only field and cannot be modified by the user through this screen.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Account Update screen is being prepared for display in any processing state, including edit mode
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Informational Message area field protection attribute is being set
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Informational Message area field is explicitly set to protected (read-only) in all screen states including edit mode; the user can read the informational messages but cannot modify the content of this field

all_rules.Rule_Name: Informational Message Area is Always Read-Only in All Screen States
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Informational Message area on the Account Update screen is always kept protected (read-only) in all screen states, including edit mode. This field is used by the system to display guidance messages and status information to the user and cannot be modified.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen is displayed and the current state is 'Account Details Not Yet Fetched' (no account has been looked up yet)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is being prepared for display
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account ID field so the user can enter an account number to search

all_rules.Rule_Name: Position Cursor on Account ID Field When Details Not Yet Fetched
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is in its initial state with no account details fetched, the cursor is automatically positioned on the Account ID field to guide the user to enter an account number to search.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen is displayed and either account data or customer data has been found and loaded, OR no changes have been detected between the original and submitted values

Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account Status field (the first editable detail field) to prompt the user to begin editing

Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field has been flagged as invalid (either blank/not supplied or containing a non-numeric, zero, or non-11-digit value)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cursor is positioned on the Account ID field so the user can correct the account number

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen is about to be displayed to the user
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen color attribute setup process begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All screen fields (Account Number, Account Status, Credit Limit, Cash Credit Limit, Current Balance, Current Cycle Credit, Current Cycle Debit, Open Date Year/Month/Day, Expiry Date Year/Month/Day, Reissue Date Year/Month/Day, Group ID, Customer Number, SSN Parts 1/2/3, FICO Score, Date of Birth Year/Month/Day, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State, Zip, Country, Phone 1 Area/Prefix/Line, Phone 2 Area/Prefix/Line, Government ID, EFT Account ID, Primary Card Holder Indicator, and Info Message) are set to their default protected display attribute with no error color highlighting

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize All Screen Fields to Default Color
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before applying any error highlighting, all screen fields are reset to their default (non-error) color state so that only fields with current errors are highlighted in red.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen is in search mode, meaning no account details have been fetched yet (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen field protection and color attributes are being set up
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Only the Account Number field (ACCTSIDA) is set to an unprotected/enterable state (DFHBMFSE); all other account and customer detail fields remain protected and no further color attribute changes are applied to detail fields

all_rules.Rule_Name: Restrict Field Availability in Account Search Mode
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is in search mode (no account details have been fetched yet), only the Account Number field is made available for user entry. All other fields remain protected and require no color change processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account update screen is being prepared for display and the program has re-entered (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Account Number field has a validation error — either it was left blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true) or it contains an invalid value (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account Number field (ACCTSIDC) is highlighted in RED (DFHRED); additionally, if the field was blank (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true), an asterisk '*' is placed in the Account Number output field (ACCTSIDO) to indicate the field must be supplied

all_rules.Rule_Name: Highlight Account Number Field in Red When Invalid
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Account Number field fails validation (either blank or contains an invalid value), it is highlighted in red to alert the user. If the field was left blank, an asterisk placeholder is displayed to indicate a required field was not supplied.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The screen color attribute setup is in progress
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The screen is in search mode (ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is true), OR the Account Number field has a blank error (FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true), OR the Account Number field has an invalid value error (FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK is true)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No further color attribute changes are applied to any account or customer detail fields, and the color setup process exits immediately (GO TO 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS-EXIT)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Stop Further Field Color Processing When Account Number Is in Error or Screen Is in Search Mode
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the screen is in search mode (no account fetched), or when the Account Number field itself is in error, no further field-level color highlighting is needed for account or customer detail fields, and the color setup process exits early.
